azeroth.name: Northrend
azeroth.desc: The ancient northern continent of Azeroth, the cradle of titan civilization and the home of the Scourge. In its icy wastes lies Icecrown Citadel — the throne room of the Lich King. Here Arthas Menethil once fell, and now his cursed soul rules the dead.

azeroth.name: Strand of the Ancients
azeroth.desc: The southern coast of Northrend, named in memory of the landing of ancient seafarers. It was here that Prince Arthas Menethil set foot on Northrend's soil in search of the demon Mal'Ganis, not yet knowing that he would return a different man. Later, Alliance forces landed here during the war against the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Isle of Conquest
azeroth.desc: A small island off the coast of Northrend that has become an arena of endless confrontation between the Alliance and the Horde. Here, the best warriors of both factions fight for control over strategic fortifications, and the island's ancient ruins remember the times of the first colonists.

azeroth.name: Refinery
azeroth.desc: A processing complex on the Isle of Conquest, built around ancient reserves of black gold. It serves to supply siege engines with fuel.

azeroth.name: Workshop
azeroth.desc: A blacksmith's shop on the Isle of Conquest where craftsmen of both factions assemble siege weapons to storm enemy fortifications.

azeroth.name: Hangar
azeroth.desc: A structure on the Isle of Conquest that houses combat airships. Whoever holds the hangar dominates the skies over the island.

azeroth.name: Quarry
azeroth.desc: An ancient quarry on the Isle of Conquest where the first settlers mined stone. It now serves as a resource for the warring armies.

azeroth.name: Docks
azeroth.desc: A harbor on the Isle of Conquest through which both factions ferry reinforcements and supplies from the mainland.

azeroth.name: Sholazar Basin
azeroth.desc: Warm tropical jungles amidst the eternal permafrost of Northrend, hidden from view by icy ridges. According to legend, the titans created this land as a preserve of life. Here dwell ancient creatures that have never known the hand of death, and in the very heart of the jungle rises a titanic complex.

azeroth.name: Borean Tundra
azeroth.desc: The cold northern coast of Northrend, washed by the icy waters of the Great Sea. The first fortresses of human colonists stood here even before the fall of Lordaeron. Today it is the front line of Alliance and Horde expeditions stepping into the lands of the Lich King.

azeroth.name: Garrosh's Landing
azeroth.desc: The Horde's beachhead in the Borean Tundra, established by the order of Garrosh Hellscream, son of Grommash. From here, Horde forces began their offensive into Northrend, striving to be the first to reach the Lich King.

azeroth.name: Coldarra
azeroth.desc: An ancient lair of the blue dragonflight, where Malygos, the Steward of Magic, retreated after going mad with grief over his dead consort. Here, among ruins and crystals, dragons guard the secrets of magic entrusted to them by the titans. Currently, Coldarra is besieged by the Scourge.

azeroth.name: The Nexus
azeroth.desc: The focal point of magical power for the blue dragons in Coldarra, hidden deep underground. One of the most mysterious places in Northrend, where flows of pure magic intertwine with the echo of Malygos's grief for his lost consort.

azeroth.name: Warsong Hold
azeroth.desc: The main stronghold of the Horde in the Borean Tundra, built by the Warsong clan. From here, the Horde advances deeper into Northrend.

azeroth.name: Riplash Strand
azeroth.desc: A stretch of rocky coastline in southern Borean Tundra, named after a monstrous sea beast from the legends of local peoples.

azeroth.name: Riplash Ruins
azeroth.desc: The ruins of an ancient settlement on the shore of Riplash Strand. The stones of these ruins remember the first colonists of Northrend.

azeroth.name: Valiance Keep
azeroth.desc: The main stronghold of the Alliance in the Borean Tundra, built on the site of old human ruins. From here, the Alliance forces begin their campaign against the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Kaskala
azeroth.desc: A small tuskarr settlement in the Borean Tundra. Here, traders and hunters exchange news and supplies.

azeroth.name: Death's Stand
azeroth.desc: A grim wasteland in the Borean Tundra where Scourge forces have set up a fortified camp. The air here is thick with the smell of decay and necrotic magic.

azeroth.name: Taunka'le Village
azeroth.desc: The ancestral home of the taunka, a peace-loving people living in harmony with the harsh nature of Northrend. Here they preserve ancient customs and tales of great ancestors.

azeroth.name: Geyser Fields
azeroth.desc: A geothermal zone in the Borean Tundra, dotted with erupting geysers. The warm springs attract rare beasts to this area.

azeroth.name: Fizzcrank Airstrip
azeroth.desc: An improvised airstrip of the gnome inventor Fizzcrank, nestled amidst the icy wasteland. Risky reconnaissance flights over Northrend are launched from here.

azeroth.name: Temple City of En'kilah
azeroth.desc: An ancient city of prophet-mages who served the titans. It is now captured by the Scourge, and its sanctuaries have been defiled by necromancy.

azeroth.name: Mosslight Pillar
azeroth.desc: One of the titanic obelisks scattered throughout Sholazar Basin. It serves as a key to the ancient mechanisms of the titans.

azeroth.name: Nesingwary Base Camp
azeroth.desc: The hunting base of the famous hunter Hemet Nesingwary in the jungles of Sholazar. From here, his team hunts the local exotic fauna.

azeroth.name: Suntouched Pillar
azeroth.desc: A titan obelisk in Sholazar Basin, radiating a soft golden glow. One of the key elements of the ancient mechanism of the preserve.

azeroth.name: Makers' Perch
azeroth.desc: A high-altitude platform in Sholazar offering a view of the entire basin. It is believed that the titans watched over their creation from here.

azeroth.name: River's Heart
azeroth.desc: The confluence of the main waterways of Sholazar Basin. The life-giving moisture feeds the lush jungles amidst the ice.

azeroth.name: Wildgrowth Mangal
azeroth.desc: Dense mangrove thickets in the heart of Sholazar. Here hide rare species of plants and animals found nowhere else in Azeroth.

azeroth.name: Skyreach Pillar
azeroth.desc: A titanic obelisk reaching into the sky above Sholazar. It symbolizes the connection between the earthly world and the celestial forces.

azeroth.name: Frenzyheart Hill
azeroth.desc: The lair of the Frenzyheart tribe — aggressive wolf-like creatures of Sholazar. Here they worship their bloodthirsty deity.

azeroth.name: Lifeblood Pillar
azeroth.desc: A titan obelisk emanating the energy of life itself. One of the four pillars supporting the Sholazar Basin preserve.

azeroth.name: Makers' Overlook
azeroth.desc: A titan observation post in eastern Sholazar. It offers a panorama of the jungles and ancient mechanisms.

azeroth.name: The Avalanche
azeroth.desc: A massive glacier frozen in the moment of its descent thousands of years ago. Like a wave, it looms over the jungles of Sholazar.

azeroth.name: Lost Lands
azeroth.desc: An area of ancient ruins in Sholazar, hidden under the jungle canopy. Traces of a forgotten civilization are preserved here.

azeroth.name: Rainspeaker Canopy
azeroth.desc: The home of the shaman Rainspeaker of the Oracles tribe. A place where ancient knowledge about the titans and their legacy is preserved.

azeroth.name: Glimmering Pillar
azeroth.desc: A titan obelisk with shimmering runes. Its light guides lost travelers in Sholazar.

azeroth.name: Savage Thicket
azeroth.desc: Impenetrable thickets in the northern part of Sholazar. The most dangerous predators of the preserve live here.

azeroth.name: Onslaught Harbor
azeroth.desc: A port in northwestern Northrend serving as a base for the Scourge. From here, ships of the undead sail into the northern seas.

azeroth.name: Bor'gorok Outpost
azeroth.desc: A taunka stronghold in the Borean Tundra, named after a legendary warrior. Warriors are trained here to defend their native lands.

azeroth.name: Amber Ledge
azeroth.desc: A rocky ledge in the Borean Tundra where valuable amber is mined. The deposits are guarded by fierce beasts.

azeroth.name: Wintergrasp
azeroth.desc: A frozen lake in the center of the zone of the same name, which has become an arena of eternal war between the Alliance and the Horde. Blood is spilled in endless battles for control over fortresses and titan relics. The icy waters hide ancient mechanisms capable of changing the course of battle.

azeroth.name: Broken Temple
azeroth.desc: A ruined sanctuary on the shores of Lake Wintergrasp. Its ruins remember the times when prayers were offered to the titans here.

azeroth.name: Glacial Falls
azeroth.desc: A cascade of frozen waterfalls on the northern shore of Lake Wintergrasp. The ice here never melts.

azeroth.name: Wintergrasp Fortress
azeroth.desc: The main citadel of the Wintergrasp zone, contested by the Alliance and the Horde. Whoever controls it controls the entire surrounding area.

azeroth.name: Sunken Ring
azeroth.desc: An ancient ring-shaped structure that sank underwater near the shores of Wintergrasp. Its purpose remains a mystery even to the mages of Dalaran.

azeroth.name: Cauldron of Flames
azeroth.desc: A volcanic depression in eastern Wintergrasp. Even among the eternal ice, springs of molten lava erupt here.

azeroth.name: Icemist Village
azeroth.desc: A taunka settlement at the foot of the glaciers. Travelers can find shelter and a warm hearth here amidst the permafrost.

azeroth.name: Azjol-Nerub
azeroth.desc: The underground kingdom of the nerubians — spider-like creatures that once ruled the underground of Northrend. Today its tunnels are captured by the Scourge and serve as their lair.

azeroth.name: Stars' Rest
azeroth.desc: An ancient cemetery in the Dragonblight where the remains of dragons who fell in battle rest. At night, stars light up above it in memory of the fallen.

azeroth.name: Agmar's Hammer
azeroth.desc: A Horde fortress in the Dragonblight, named after the warlord Agmar. From here, the Horde advances against the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Moa'ki Harbor
azeroth.desc: A port on the eastern coast of the Dragonblight. From here, ships depart for the icy shores of Northrend.

azeroth.name: Wyrmrest Temple
azeroth.desc: A majestic temple built by dragons in the very heart of the Dragonblight. The Wyrmrest Accord, uniting all dragonflights to fight the Scourge, convenes here. The fate of all Azeroth is decided beneath its vaults.

azeroth.name: Galakrond's Rest
azeroth.desc: The resting place of Galakrond — an ancient dragon whose breath could destroy entire cities. His remains still emanate dark energy.

azeroth.name: Crystal Vice
azeroth.desc: A canyon filled with crystals of monstrous magical power. Travelers who succumb to their influence never return.

azeroth.name: Dragonblight
azeroth.desc: A vast icy plateau that became the site of mass dragon deaths in ancient wars. Thousands of bones rest here, and the earth is saturated with death magic. Today it is one of the key zones of confrontation with the Scourge.

azeroth.name: New Hearthglen
azeroth.desc: An Alliance settlement in the Dragonblight, founded by settlers from Lordaeron. Here they preserve the traditions of fallen kingdoms.

azeroth.name: Forgotten Shore
azeroth.desc: A shore on the eastern side of the Dragonblight where the waves wash up wreckage and the bodies of the fallen.

azeroth.name: Venomspite
azeroth.desc: A Scourge camp in the Dragonblight where deadly poisons are prepared. The air here is thick with caustic fumes.

azeroth.name: Wintergarde Keep
azeroth.desc: An Alliance stronghold in the Dragonblight, built on the site of ancient ruins. From here, the Alliance coordinates its fight against the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Naxxramas
azeroth.desc: A flying Scourge citadel hovering over the Dragonblight. Its halls are home to the Lich King's most powerful servants, including the archlich Kel'Thuzad. One of the most dangerous places in Northrend.

azeroth.name: Light's Trust
azeroth.desc: A Silver Dawn stronghold in the Dragonblight. Knights of the Light prepare here for the decisive battle against the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Windrunner's Overlook
azeroth.desc: An observation post named in honor of the legendary Ranger-General. It offers a view of the northern expanses of the Dragonblight.

azeroth.name: Unbound Thicket
azeroth.desc: An area of wild forest in the Dragonblight untouched by human hands. Spirits that recognize no authority dwell here.

azeroth.name: Crystalsong Forest
azeroth.desc: A magical forest where trees turned into crystals after a fall of magical energy. Beneath their canopy, a crystalline song enchants travelers. One of the most beautiful and mysterious places in Northrend.

azeroth.name: Forlorn Woods
azeroth.desc: A dark part of the Crystalsong Forest where the crystals have dimmed and life has faded. The local spirits have abandoned these places.

azeroth.name: Violet Stand
azeroth.desc: A Kirin Tor camp in the Crystalsong Forest. Mages from Dalaran study the crystalline magic of the forest here.

azeroth.name: Decrepit Flow
azeroth.desc: A petrified lava flow frozen millennia ago. Its bed is covered in cracks and crystals.

azeroth.name: Argent Vanguard
azeroth.desc: The forward base of the Argent Crusade in the Crystalsong Forest. From here, the knights of the Light prepare for the final assault on Icecrown Citadel.

azeroth.name: Sunreaver's Command
azeroth.desc: A blood elf camp in the Crystalsong Forest, directed against the Scourge. Mages and rangers of the Horde conduct reconnaissance here.

azeroth.name: Frosthold
azeroth.desc: A dwarven stronghold in the Crystalsong Forest, carved directly into the rock. From here, dwarven expeditions explore ancient titanic ruins.

azeroth.name: Icecrown Citadel
azeroth.desc: The main fortress of the Lich King, towering over the Icecrown Glacier. Here, on the highest spire of Azeroth, Arthas Menethil sits on the Frozen Throne. This is where all paths lead for the heroes who have challenged the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Corp'rethar: The Horror Gate
azeroth.desc: The Horror Gate — a giant bone arch leading to the Scourge's lair. Armies of the undead pass through it, heading south.

azeroth.name: Fleshwerks
azeroth.desc: The terrifying factory of the Scourge, where monstrous creatures are created from the bodies of prisoners. The air here is thick with blood and necromancy.

azeroth.name: Icecrown Glacier
azeroth.desc: A massive glacier upon which Icecrown Citadel rises. Its icy walls have witnessed the greatest battles in the history of Azeroth.

azeroth.name: Ymirheim
azeroth.desc: A fortress of the vrykul serving the Scourge. Its stone walls tremble under the heavy tread of giants.

azeroth.name: Mord'rethar: The Death Gate
azeroth.desc: The Death Gate — the second passage into the lands of the Scourge. Through it, the undead exit onto the plains of the Dragonblight.

azeroth.name: Bombardment
azeroth.desc: A breach in the walls of the Citadel made by the forces of the Argent Vanguard. A continuous battle for every step takes place here.

azeroth.name: Jotunheim
azeroth.desc: A fortress of frost giants in western Icecrown. Its inhabitants serve the Lich King but harbor plans of their own.

azeroth.name: Saronite mines
azeroth.desc: A quarry where saronite — the metal of the undead — is mined. Armor for the Scourge's most powerful servants is forged from it.

azeroth.name: Shadow Vault
azeroth.desc: A dark repository of the Scourge where powerful artifacts are kept. It is guarded by forces that have no place among the living.

azeroth.name: Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate
azeroth.desc: The Desolation Gate — the third passage into the Scourge citadel. It is guarded by ice monsters and undead squads.

azeroth.name: Sindragosa's Fall
azeroth.desc: A canyon where Sindragosa fell — an ancient dragon turned to serve the Lich King. Her icy breath is still felt in these rocks.

azeroth.name: Scourgeholme
azeroth.desc: A Scourge fortress in eastern Icecrown. The main forces of the undead are concentrated here.

azeroth.name: Valkyrion
azeroth.desc: The Hall of the Val'kyr — winged warrior maidens of the Scourge. Here they prepare for battles and gather the souls of the fallen.

azeroth.name: Icecrown
azeroth.desc: A vast icy wasteland around the Citadel, the heart of the Lich King's domain. The main forces of the Scourge and its fortresses are located here.

azeroth.name: Lost Glacier
azeroth.desc: An ancient glacier in northern Northrend, hidden from view by eternal blizzards. Creatures that have not seen the sun for millennia live here.

azeroth.name: Argent Tournament Grounds
azeroth.desc: A huge arena erected by the Argent Crusade to gather forces before the assault on the Citadel. Knights of all nations of Azeroth compete here in valor and prepare for the final battle.

azeroth.name: Snowdrift Plains
azeroth.desc: Endless snow-covered fields in eastern Icecrown. The foot of a living being rarely steps here.

azeroth.name: Frozen Sea
azeroth.desc: Cold waters washing the shores of Northrend from the south. Icebergs float here, and monsters of the depths lurk underwater.

azeroth.name: Temple of Storms
azeroth.desc: An ancient sanctuary dedicated to the forces of the storm. Its halls are filled with the crash of thunder and flashes of lightning.

azeroth.name: Grom'arsh Crash-Site
azeroth.desc: The wreckage of the Horde ship 'Grom'arsh', which crashed against the icy rocks of Northrend. Survivors have established a camp here.

azeroth.name: Ulduar
azeroth.desc: An ancient titan complex in the Storm Peaks serving as a prison for Yogg-Saron, the Old God of madness. The greatest secrets of the titans are kept here, and its halls are guarded by mechanical watchers. One of the most grandiose structures in Azeroth.

azeroth.name: North Sea
azeroth.desc: Cold waters north of Northrend, frozen in ice for most of the year. Paths to the farthest corners of Azeroth pass through here.

azeroth.name: Storm Peaks
azeroth.desc: A mountain range in northeastern Northrend home to frost giants and snow beasts. Ulduar, an ancient titan complex, is hidden in its depths.

azeroth.name: Terrace of the Makers
azeroth.desc: A platform on the slopes of the Storm Peaks offering a view of Ulduar. It is believed that the titans watched over their creations from here.

azeroth.name: Camp Tunka'lo
azeroth.desc: A taunka camp in the Storm Peaks. Hunters and trackers exchange news and prepare for expeditions here.

azeroth.name: Thunderfall
azeroth.desc: The place where, according to legend, the lightning of a titan struck. Geysers erupt here, and discharges of pure energy sparkle.

azeroth.name: Dun Niffelem
azeroth.desc: A settlement of frost dwarves in the Storm Peaks. Descendants of the ancient servants of the titans live here.

azeroth.name: Brunnhildar Village
azeroth.desc: A village of warrior women in the Storm Peaks who worship the val'kyr. Future chosen ones of the goddess are trained here.

azeroth.name: Howling Fjord
azeroth.desc: A fjord in eastern Northrend named for the constant howling of the winds. Ancient fortresses of the vrykul vikings stand here.

azeroth.name: Grizzly Hills
azeroth.desc: A hilly area near the Howling Fjord covered in sparse woodland. Wolves and bears live here.

azeroth.name: Zul'Drak
azeroth.desc: An ancient city of ice trolls (Drakkari), built on the slopes of the Howling Fjord. Its temples and altars hold the dark secrets of bloody rituals.

azeroth.name: Ebon Watch
azeroth.desc: An observation post of the Knights of the Ebon Blade in the Dragonblight. From here, they monitor the movements of the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Thrym's End
azeroth.desc: An icy gorge in the Dragonblight where the giant Thrym dwells. His lair and sacrificial altars are located here.

azeroth.name: Voltarus
azeroth.desc: A flying Scourge fortress hovering over the Dragonblight. One of the Lich King's most loyal servants commands from here.

azeroth.name: Zeramas
azeroth.desc: An ancient altar of the ice trolls in the Dragonblight. Sacrifices are offered here to the dark gods.

azeroth.name: Light's Breach
azeroth.desc: A Silver Dawn stronghold in the Dragonblight. Knights of the Light fight the darkness of the Scourge here.

azeroth.name: Drak'Tharon Keep
azeroth.desc: A grim fortress of the ice trolls, now captured by the Scourge through the betrayal of Drakuru. Its walls remember bloody rituals and battles.

azeroth.name: Zeb'Halak
azeroth.desc: An ancient troll altar in the Dragonblight. The spirits of ancestors are worshipped here.

azeroth.name: Granite Springs
azeroth.desc: Springs in the Dragonblight flowing from beneath granite rocks. Their water has healing properties.

azeroth.name: Conquest Hold
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in the Dragonblight. From here, the Horde advances against the forces of the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Venture Bay
azeroth.desc: A port of the Venture Company in the Dragonblight. Brisk trade in anything that can be sold takes place here.

azeroth.name: Gundrak
azeroth.desc: The ancient capital of the Drakkari empire, the ice trolls of Zul'Drak. Mighty warriors and shamans dwell here.

azeroth.name: Argent Stand
azeroth.desc: A forward base of the Silver Dawn in Zul'Drak. From here, knights of the Light fight the trolls and the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Altar of Sseratus
azeroth.desc: The altar of the serpent god of the trolls in Zul'Drak. Bloody sacrifices are made here to gain his favor.

azeroth.name: Altar of Rhunok
azeroth.desc: The altar of the rhino god in Zul'Drak. His followers believe he grants strength and endurance.

azeroth.name: Zol'Maz Stronghold
azeroth.desc: A troll stronghold in Zul'Drak. Warriors are trained here to defend the sacred lands.

azeroth.name: Altar of Mam'toth
azeroth.desc: The altar of the mammoth god in Zul'Drak. His priests perform ancient rituals here.

azeroth.name: Altar of Quetz'lun
azeroth.desc: The altar of the winged serpent in Zul'Drak. It is believed to bring luck in hunting.

azeroth.name: Zim'Torga
azeroth.desc: An ancient altar in Zul'Drak dedicated to the patron spirit of the trolls.

azeroth.name: Altar of Har'koa
azeroth.desc: The altar of the snow leopard god in Zul'Drak. His followers believe he grants strength and agility.

azeroth.name: Kolramas
azeroth.desc: An ancient troll settlement in Zul'Drak. Traditions of the ancestors are preserved here and initiation rites are held.

azeroth.name: Silverbrook
azeroth.desc: A small settlement in the Howling Fjord located on the riverbank. Fishermen and hunters live here.

azeroth.name: Blue Sky Logging Grounds
azeroth.desc: A lumberjack camp in the Howling Fjord. Timber is harvested here for construction and trade.

azeroth.name: Grizzlemaw
azeroth.desc: A settlement of bear-like creatures in the Howling Fjord. Bear warriors and their shamans live here.

azeroth.name: Amberpine Lodge
azeroth.desc: A tavern in the Howling Fjord where travelers can rest and catch up on the latest news.

azeroth.name: Voldrune
azeroth.desc: An ancient vrykul burial mound in the Howling Fjord. The remains of their great warriors rest here.

azeroth.name: Thor Modan
azeroth.desc: An ancient vrykul fortress in the Howling Fjord. Its walls remember battles with dragons and giants.

azeroth.name: Ursoc's Den
azeroth.desc: The lair of the mighty demigod bear Ursoc. He dwells here with his followers.

azeroth.name: Westfall Brigade Encampment
azeroth.desc: A camp of Westfall militiamen in the Howling Fjord. Recruits are trained here to combat the threats of Northrend.

azeroth.name: Drakil'jin Ruins
azeroth.desc: The ruins of an ancient troll city in the Howling Fjord. Spirits of fallen warriors dwell here.

azeroth.name: Camp Oneqwah
azeroth.desc: A taunka camp in the Howling Fjord. Hunters and their families migrate here.

azeroth.name: Dun Argol
azeroth.desc: A vrykul fortress in the Howling Fjord. Warriors are trained here to defend their lands.

azeroth.name: Bloodmoon Isle
azeroth.desc: A small island off the coast of the Howling Fjord. A troll sanctuary dedicated to the blood moon is located here.

azeroth.name: Apothecary Camp
azeroth.desc: A Forsaken camp in the Howling Fjord. Apothecaries conduct their grim experiments here.

azeroth.name: Westguard Keep
azeroth.desc: An Alliance stronghold in the Howling Fjord. From here, Alliance forces control the western coast.

azeroth.name: Gjalerbron
azeroth.desc: An ancient vrykul burial mound in the Howling Fjord. Their kings rest here, and priests perform dark rituals.

azeroth.name: Camp Winterhoof
azeroth.desc: A taunka camp in the Howling Fjord. Hunters and their families live here, weathering the harsh winter.

azeroth.name: Fort Wildervar
azeroth.desc: An Alliance stronghold in the Howling Fjord. Soldiers are trained here to fight the vrykul and the Scourge.

azeroth.name: Skorn
azeroth.desc: An ancient vrykul burial mound on the shore of the Howling Fjord. Their great warriors are buried here.

azeroth.name: Ember Clutch
azeroth.desc: A lair of fire-breathing dragons in the Howling Fjord. They lay eggs and protect their offspring here.

azeroth.name: Kamagua
azeroth.desc: A small settlement in the Howling Fjord where fishermen and traders live.

azeroth.name: Scalawag Point
azeroth.desc: A pirate camp on the coast of the Howling Fjord. Smugglers and adventurers divide their spoils here.

azeroth.name: Ancient Lift
azeroth.desc: A titan mechanism that lifts travelers to the plateau of the Howling Fjord. Its gears have been running for thousands of years.

azeroth.name: New Agamand
azeroth.desc: A Forsaken settlement in the Howling Fjord, named after the ruined Agamand Mills. Those who serve Sylvanas live here.

azeroth.name: Valgarde
azeroth.desc: The main Alliance port in the Howling Fjord, founded by an expedition from Lordaeron. The path deep into Northrend begins here. The main forces of the Alliance on the eastern coast are concentrated here.

azeroth.name: Utgarde Keep
azeroth.desc: A mighty vrykul fortress carved into the rock of the Howling Fjord. King Ymiron rules his people here and prepares an invasion of Azeroth. One of the most impregnable places in Northrend.

azeroth.name: Giants' Run
azeroth.desc: A road built by giants in the Howling Fjord. Its stones remember the tread of ancient giants.

azeroth.name: Vengeance Landing
azeroth.desc: An Alliance camp in eastern Howling Fjord. The offensive against Utgarde Keep begins here.

azeroth.name: Nifflevar
azeroth.desc: An ancient vrykul settlement in the Howling Fjord. Their traditional houses and altars are preserved here.

azeroth.name: Explorers' League Outpost
azeroth.desc: An Explorers' League base in the Howling Fjord. Dwarves study ancient ruins and titanic mechanisms from here.

azeroth.name: Chamber of Ancient Relics
azeroth.desc: A repository of ancient titan artifacts hidden in the depths of Northrend. Relics capable of changing the course of history rest here.

azeroth.name: Hrothgar's Landing
azeroth.desc: A camp on the northern coast of Northrend, named after an ancient hero. Expeditions to the farthest corners of the icy continent begin here.

azeroth.name: Kalimdor
azeroth.desc: The vast western continent of Azeroth, home to night elves, tauren, orcs, and many other peoples. Ancient forests, scorched wastelands, and sacred mountains stretch across it. Kalimdor holds the memory of the War of the Ancients and the Sundering, and its lands are still full of mysteries.

azeroth.name: Frostsaber Rock
azeroth.desc: A rocky ledge in Winterspring where frostsabers dwell. Night elf hunters undergo their initiation rite here.

azeroth.name: Hidden Grove
azeroth.desc: A secret grove in Winterspring where druids perform their rituals away from prying eyes.

azeroth.name: Starfall Village
azeroth.desc: A night elf village in Winterspring living in harmony with nature. Ancient traditions and legends are preserved here.

azeroth.name: Everlook
azeroth.desc: A bustling town in Winterspring known for its tavern and trade. Adventurers from all over Kalimdor flock here.

azeroth.name: Lake Kel'Theril
azeroth.desc: A frozen lake in Winterspring hiding ancient elven ruins beneath the ice. Local spirits find no rest.

azeroth.name: Mazthoril
azeroth.desc: A cave in Winterspring serving as a home for blue dragons. Ancient magical artifacts are kept here.

azeroth.name: Winterspring
azeroth.desc: A snowy region in northeastern Kalimdor, hidden from outsiders by mountain ranges. Frostsabers, owlbeasts, and other creatures accustomed to the cold live here. Ancient elven ruins and dragon lairs are hidden in its depths.

azeroth.name: Azshara
azeroth.desc: The sea-washed coast in northeastern Kalimdor, named after Queen Azshara. Ancient elven ruins and treasure hunter camps stretch here. Once the lands of the Highborne, now wild nature and pirate coves.

azeroth.name: Tower of Eldara
azeroth.desc: An ancient elven tower in Azshara, ruined by time. Its ruins remember the grandeur of the night elf empire.

azeroth.name: Sable Ridge
azeroth.desc: A mountain ridge in Azshara covered in dark rocks. Predators that fear neither day nor night live here.

azeroth.name: Darnassian Base Camp
azeroth.desc: A night elf camp in Azshara from which they observe the ancient ruins and guard the borders of their lands.

azeroth.name: Frostwhisper Gorge
azeroth.desc: A dark gorge in Winterspring where the wind whispers with icy voices. Spirits that have not found peace dwell here.

azeroth.name: Bilgewater Harbor
azeroth.desc: A goblin port in Azshara known for its noisy trade and smuggling. Ships depart from here to the shores of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

azeroth.name: Ravencrest Monument
azeroth.desc: A monument in Ashenvale erected in honor of an ancient hero. It reminds of past battles and the sacrifices made for peace.

azeroth.name: Moonglade
azeroth.desc: The sacred glade of the druids in the very heart of Kalimdor, hidden from mortal eyes. Eternal spring reigns here, and the spirits of nature guard the peace. The Cenarion Circle convenes in Moonglade to decide the fate of Azeroth's nature.

azeroth.name: Nighthaven
azeroth.desc: A settlement in Moonglade where druids and their guests can rest and exchange knowledge.

azeroth.name: Stormrage Barrow Dens
azeroth.desc: Ancient barrow dens in Moonglade inhabited by the spirits of druids. Malfurion Stormrage conducted his rituals here.

azeroth.name: Lake Elune'ara
azeroth.desc: A sacred lake in Moonglade named after the goddess Elune. Its waters have healing properties.

azeroth.name: Shrine of Remulos
azeroth.desc: A shrine in Moonglade dedicated to Remulos, son of Cenarius. Ancient knowledge about nature and its forces is kept here.

azeroth.name: Shatterspear War Camp
azeroth.desc: A camp of the Shatterspear tribe of trolls in Moonglade. They prepare for battles and defend their lands here.

azeroth.name: Shatterspear Vale
azeroth.desc: A vale in Moonglade where the Shatterspear trolls live. Their village preserves ancient customs.

azeroth.name: Secret Lab
azeroth.desc: A hidden laboratory in Azshara where forbidden experiments are conducted. Its doors are closed to outsiders.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Eldarath
azeroth.desc: Ancient elven ruins in Azshara holding the memory of a fallen civilization. The magic of the past is still felt here.

azeroth.name: Doom's Vigil
azeroth.desc: A watchtower in Azshara guarding the approaches to the ancient ruins. Its warriors are ready to repel any threat.

azeroth.name: Forge of Supplication
azeroth.desc: An ancient forge in Azshara where elves forged weapons and armor. Its furnaces went out many centuries ago.

azeroth.name: Seat of the Chosen
azeroth.desc: A meeting place of ancient elves in Azshara where the fate of the empire was decided. Now only ruins and silence remain.

azeroth.name: Nordrassil
azeroth.desc: The great World Tree planted on Mount Hyjal after the Sundering. It connects the mortal world with the Emerald Dream and protects Kalimdor from ancient threats.

azeroth.name: Mount Hyjal
azeroth.desc: A sacred mountain in central Kalimdor where Nordrassil and the lair of ancient forces are located. The legendary Battle of Mount Hyjal, which determined the fate of Azeroth, took place here. Today it is the land of druids and nature spirits.

azeroth.name: Circle of Cinders
azeroth.desc: An ancient circle in the mountains of Hyjal where druids performed purification rituals. The embers of a great fire still smolder here.

azeroth.name: Shrine of Aviana
azeroth.desc: A shrine in the mountains of Hyjal dedicated to Aviana, mistress of birds. Her feathers and ancient totems are kept here.

azeroth.name: Timbermaw Hold
azeroth.desc: A village of the Timbermaw furbolgs in Winterspring. They live here in harmony with the forest and worship the spirits of nature.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Mathystra
azeroth.desc: Ancient elven ruins in Winterspring. Their stones remember the times before the Sundering.

azeroth.name: Lor'danel
azeroth.desc: An ancient elven city in Winterspring, now lying in ruins. Its towers are overgrown with moss and ice.

azeroth.name: Darkshore
azeroth.desc: A grim coast in western Kalimdor devastated by the Cataclysm. Ruined night elf villages and ancient ruins stretch here. Once a flourishing land, it now struggles for survival.

azeroth.name: Ashenvale
azeroth.desc: An ancient forest in western Kalimdor, sacred to the night elves. Giant trees grow here, and the air is saturated with the magic of nature. A constant struggle between elves, orcs, and demonic forces takes place in the forest.

azeroth.name: Durotar
azeroth.desc: A scorched wasteland in eastern Kalimdor that became home to the orcs after the fall of Lordaeron. Orgrimmar, the capital of the Horde, stands here. The land is harsh, but its people are tempered in battle.

azeroth.name: Dustwallow Marsh
azeroth.desc: Vast swamps in eastern Kalimdor shrouded in mist and teeming with dangers. Dragons, naga, and ancient spirits dwell here. Theramore, an Alliance stronghold, stands in the center of the marsh.

azeroth.name: Thousand Needles
azeroth.desc: A canyon in southern Kalimdor dotted with sharp rocks. Coyotes, goblins, and other adventurers live here. The path to Tanaris passes through it.

azeroth.name: Tanaris
azeroth.desc: A vast desert in southern Kalimdor with dunes and oases. Gadgetzan, a goblin city, and ancient troll ruins are located here. The desert is full of dangers and treasures.

azeroth.name: Uldum
azeroth.desc: An ancient desert in southern Kalimdor hiding a titan complex beneath the sands. Tol'vir and other titan creations live here. Uldum holds the secrets of the origin of life on Azeroth.

azeroth.name: Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom
azeroth.desc: An ancient qiraji city-fortress in Silithus that served as a prison for the Old God C'Thun. One of the greatest battles in the history of Azeroth took place here. Today its halls are full of horrors and secrets.

azeroth.name: Silithus
azeroth.desc: A desert region in southern Kalimdor where Ahn'Qiraj is located. The land is saturated with the magic of the Old Gods and their servants. Adventurers from all over Azeroth gather here.

azeroth.name: Feralas
azeroth.desc: Ancient jungles in western Kalimdor hiding the ruins of elven civilization. Gnolls, naga, and other dangerous creatures live here. A night elf village is hidden in the thicket of the jungle.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Feathermoon
azeroth.desc: Ancient ruins in Feralas left from an elven fortress. Their stones remember the battles of the past.

azeroth.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
azeroth.desc: A night elf stronghold in Feralas guarding ancient ruins and the borders of their lands. Rangers and druids are trained here.

azeroth.name: Desolace
azeroth.desc: A scorched wasteland in western Kalimdor where green plains once bloomed. Today it is the land of centaurs, marauders, and ancient spirits. Desolation and an eternal struggle for survival reign here.

azeroth.name: Stonetalon Mountains
azeroth.desc: A mountain range in central Kalimdor covered with forests and gorges. Tauren, orcs, and ancient spirits dwell here. Important trade routes pass through the mountains.

azeroth.name: Veiled Sea
azeroth.desc: The waters washing the western coast of Kalimdor. Sunken cities and ancient monsters hide here.

azeroth.name: Teldrassil
azeroth.desc: A huge World Tree planted by the night elves after the Sundering. Darnassus, the capital of the night elves, stretches across its branches. The tree protects Kalimdor from threats from the sea.

azeroth.name: Darnassus
azeroth.desc: The capital of the night elves, stretching across the branches of Teldrassil. Ancient knowledge and traditions are preserved here. Today the city lies in ruins after the burning of Teldrassil.

azeroth.name: Bloodmyst Isle
azeroth.desc: An island off the western coast of Kalimdor covered in crimson crystals. The Exodar crashed here, and the land is saturated with fel. Today it is home to the draenei and their allies.

azeroth.name: Wyrmscar Island
azeroth.desc: A small island off the coast of Kalimdor where the remains of dragons rest. Its cliffs are washed by cold waters.

azeroth.name: Bloodcurse Isle
azeroth.desc: An island off the coast of Kalimdor cursed by ancient magic. Creatures best left undisturbed live here.

azeroth.name: Warp Piston
azeroth.desc: A draenei mechanism on Bloodmyst Isle designed to accelerate movement. Its gears run on magic.

azeroth.name: Amberweb Pass
azeroth.desc: A mountain pass on Bloodmyst Isle inhabited by giant spiders. Their webs cover the rocks with amber light.

azeroth.name: Axxarien
azeroth.desc: Ancient ruins on Bloodmyst Isle left by an unknown civilization. Their stones hold dark secrets.

azeroth.name: Blood Watch
azeroth.desc: A watchtower on Bloodmyst Isle guarding the approaches to the ancient ruins.

azeroth.name: Wrathscale Lair
azeroth.desc: A naga lair on Bloodmyst Isle. They make plans here to seize the surrounding lands.

azeroth.name: Kessel's Crossing
azeroth.desc: A crossroads on Bloodmyst Isle where travelers can rest and replenish supplies.

azeroth.name: Nazzivian
azeroth.desc: Ancient ruins on Bloodmyst Isle left from the draenei civilization. Magic is still felt here.

azeroth.name: Blacksilt Shore
azeroth.desc: The coast on Bloodmyst Isle covered in black silt. Creatures adapted to mud and darkness live here.

azeroth.name: Cryo-Core
azeroth.desc: A draenei mechanism on Bloodmyst Isle designed for cooling. Its magic sustains life in harsh conditions.

azeroth.name: Vector Coil
azeroth.desc: A draenei power plant on Bloodmyst Isle. It powers their mechanisms and devices.

azeroth.name: Stillpine Hold
azeroth.desc: A settlement of the Stillpine furbolgs on Bloodmyst Isle. They live here in peace with the draenei.

azeroth.name: Emberglade
azeroth.desc: A glade on Bloodmyst Isle where the earth is still smoldering after the Exodar's crash.

azeroth.name: Azure Watch
azeroth.desc: A draenei watchtower on Bloodmyst Isle. They watch the coast from here.

azeroth.name: Ammen Vale
azeroth.desc: A valley on Bloodmyst Isle where ancient draenei ruins stretch. The memory of their fallen home is preserved here.

azeroth.name: Nestlewood Hills
azeroth.desc: Hills on Bloodmyst Isle where owlbeasts live. They build their nests and hunt here.

azeroth.name: Exodar
azeroth.desc: The draenei's dimensional ship that crashed on Bloodmyst Isle. It is now their capital and last refuge. The Light of the Naaru and the hope for rebirth are preserved here.

azeroth.name: Odesyus' Landing
azeroth.desc: A camp on Bloodmyst Isle where draenei and their allies prepare for exploration.

azeroth.name: Bristlelimb Village
azeroth.desc: A furbolg village on Bloodmyst Isle. They live here in harmony with nature.

azeroth.name: Silvermyst Isle
azeroth.desc: A small island off the coast of Kalimdor covered in silvery mist. Rare creatures live here.

azeroth.name: Azuremyst Isle
azeroth.desc: An island off the western coast of Kalimdor covered in azure forests. Draenei and furbolgs live here, and the land holds traces of ancient civilizations. Today it is a peaceful region, but its tranquility is often disturbed by naga and demons.

azeroth.name: South Seas
azeroth.desc: Warm waters south of Kalimdor where countless islands stretch. Pirate coves and sunken treasures hide here.

azeroth.name: Lost Isles
azeroth.desc: A group of islands off the coast of Kalimdor hidden by mist. Creatures that have never known civilization live here. The islands are full of secrets and dangers.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Vashj'elan
azeroth.desc: Ancient elven ruins on the Lost Isles. Their stones remember the times before the Sundering.

azeroth.name: Horde Base Camp
azeroth.desc: The main Horde camp on the Lost Isles. From here, the Horde conducts reconnaissance and prepares for battle.

azeroth.name: Shipwreck Shore
azeroth.desc: The coast of the Lost Isles, strewn with ship wreckage. Many navigators have been shipwrecked here.

azeroth.name: Alliance Beachhead
azeroth.desc: The Alliance camp on the Lost Isles. Alliance forces begin their exploration of these lands from here.

azeroth.name: Wild Overlook
azeroth.desc: An observation post on the Lost Isles offering a view of the forest expanses.

azeroth.name: Warchief's Lookout
azeroth.desc: A Horde watchpost on the Lost Isles. Enemy movements are monitored here.

azeroth.name: Slave Pits
azeroth.desc: A grim place on the Lost Isles where prisoners are kept. Cruelty and despair reign here.

azeroth.name: Gallywix Docks
azeroth.desc: A shipyard on the Lost Isles owned by goblins. Ships for trade and war are built here.

azeroth.name: KTC Oil Platform
azeroth.desc: An oil rig of the Trade Company on the Lost Isles. Black gold is extracted here without regard for the consequences.

azeroth.name: Bilgewater Lumber Yard
azeroth.desc: Logging operations of the Bilgewater cartel on the Lost Isles. Goblins cut down ancient forests here for profit.

azeroth.name: Maelstrom
azeroth.desc: A huge whirlpool in the center of Azeroth formed after the Sundering. It connects the mortal world with the Underworld and serves as a prison for ancient forces. The Heart of Azeroth is now located here.

azeroth.name: Heart of Azeroth
azeroth.desc: A sacred place in the center of the Maelstrom where the essence of the world itself is kept. Heroes of Azeroth draw strength here to fight threats.

azeroth.name: Storm's Eye Overlook
azeroth.desc: An observation post near the Maelstrom offering a view of the churning waters. The forces rushing from the depths are monitored here.

azeroth.name: Darkmoon Island
azeroth.desc: A mysterious island that appears once a month under the light of the Darkmoon. The Darkmoon Faire with its attractions and mysteries stretches here. The island is full of magic and secrets that remain unsolved to this day.

azeroth.name: Kezan
azeroth.desc: The homeland of the goblins, located on an island in the South Seas. Cities and factories stretch here, and the air is saturated with smoke and the smell of money. Kezan is the center of trade and technology.

azeroth.name: Platinum Sands
azeroth.desc: A beach on Kezan covered in snow-white sand. Wealthy goblins rest here and conduct deals.

azeroth.name: Crapopolis
azeroth.desc: A town on Kezan known for its noisy life and cheap entertainment.

azeroth.name: Rocketzan
azeroth.desc: A spaceport on Kezan from which goblins launch their rockets. The spirit of invention and adventurism reigns here.

azeroth.name: V.M.Z.
azeroth.desc: A dangerous mechanical factory on Kezan where weapons and machinery are produced.

azeroth.name: R&D
azeroth.desc: A research center on Kezan where goblins develop new technologies.

azeroth.name: Lucky Strike Mines
azeroth.desc: Mines on Kezan where rare ores are extracted. Goblins and their hired workers toil here.

azeroth.name: Mount Kajaro
azeroth.desc: A volcano on Kezan named after an ancient goblin hero. Its slopes are rich in minerals.

azeroth.name: Gallywix's Villa
azeroth.desc: A luxurious villa on Kezan owned by Trade Prince Gallywix. The most important goblin deals are made here.

azeroth.name: Bilgewater Port
azeroth.desc: The main port of Kezan through which trade with the rest of Azeroth is conducted. It is noisy, crowded, and dangerous here.

azeroth.name: Drudgetown
azeroth.desc: The poor district of Kezan where workers and minor employees live. Poverty and despair reign here.

azeroth.name: Kajaro Field
azeroth.desc: An open field on Kezan where machinery and weapons are tested.

azeroth.name: First Bank of Kezan
azeroth.desc: The main bank of Kezan where the wealth of goblin trade princes is stored. Its vaults are guarded by the best mercenaries.

azeroth.name: KTC Headquarters
azeroth.desc: The main office of the Trade Company on Kezan. Trade operations throughout Azeroth are managed from here.

azeroth.name: Kaja'mine
azeroth.desc: A mine on Kezan where the rare mineral kaja'mite is extracted. It is used in the most advanced goblin technologies.

azeroth.name: Zandalar
azeroth.desc: An ancient continent in southern Azeroth, the home of the troll empire. Dense jungles, pyramids, and ancient temples stretch here. Zandalar holds the secrets of the loa and the grandeur of forgotten ages.

azeroth.name: Zuldazar
azeroth.desc: The capital of Zandalar, stretching among ancient pyramids and temples. The Zandalari, who preserve the traditions of their ancestors, live here. The Great Pyramid rises in the center of the city.

azeroth.name: Vol'dun
azeroth.desc: A swampy region in northern Zandalar shrouded in mist and gloom. Trolls of the Blood Moon tribe and their dark gods dwell here.

azeroth.name: Nazmir
azeroth.desc: Grim swamps in eastern Zandalar saturated with death and decay. Cultists and creatures best left undisturbed live here.

azeroth.name: Dazar'alor
azeroth.desc: An ancient troll city in Zandalar, now lying in ruins. Its walls remember the grandeur of the empire.

azeroth.name: Talanji's Rebuke
azeroth.desc: A cove on the coast of Zandalar named after the hero Talanji. Ships and fishermen take shelter here.

azeroth.name: Atal'Gral
azeroth.desc: An ancient troll temple in Zandalar. The loa are worshipped here and sacrifices are made.

azeroth.name: Tal'gurub
azeroth.desc: An ancient troll city in Zandalar, now captured by the forces of darkness. Creatures that even death fears live here.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Auberdine
azeroth.desc: The ruined village of the night elves on Darkshore. Life once bustled here, but now only ruins remind of the past.

azeroth.name: Eye of the Vortex
azeroth.desc: A magical place in Ashenvale where the forces of nature rage. Druids draw energy here for their rituals.

azeroth.name: Felwood
azeroth.desc: A dark forest in Ashenvale saturated with fel. Demons and creatures corrupted by dark magic live here.

azeroth.name: Whisperwind Grove
azeroth.desc: A sacred grove in Ashenvale where Elune is worshipped. Silence and peace reign here.

azeroth.name: Talonbranch Glade
azeroth.desc: A forest glade in Ashenvale where druids dwell. They learn to understand the language of nature here.

azeroth.name: Bloodvenom Post
azeroth.desc: A watchtower in Felwood. Demonic activity is monitored here and borders are guarded.

azeroth.name: Grove of the Ancients
azeroth.desc: A sacred grove in Ashenvale where the Ancients, spirits of nature, dwell. They guard the peace of the forest here.

azeroth.name: Jaedenar
azeroth.desc: A dark place in Felwood where satyrs and demons dwell. Evil and corruption reign here.

azeroth.name: Master's Glaive
azeroth.desc: An ancient monument in Ashenvale reminding of past battles.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Constellas
azeroth.desc: Ancient elven ruins in Ashenvale. Their stones remember the times before the Sundering.

azeroth.name: Emerald Sanctuary
azeroth.desc: A druid sanctuary in Ashenvale dedicated to the Emerald Dream. Knowledge about nature and its forces is kept here.

azeroth.name: Jadefire Glen
azeroth.desc: A valley in Ashenvale where green fire illuminates ancient ruins. Spirits that have not found peace dwell here.

azeroth.name: Hellscream's Watch
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in Ashenvale named after Grommash Hellscream. From here, the Horde controls the forest roads.

azeroth.name: Blackfathom Deeps
azeroth.desc: An underground complex in Ashenvale dedicated to the Old Gods. Naga and cultists worshipping the darkness live here.

azeroth.name: Orendil's Retreat
azeroth.desc: A night elf camp in Ashenvale. Rangers rest here and prepare for patrols.

azeroth.name: Zoram'gar Outpost
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in Ashenvale. From here, the Horde conducts reconnaissance and guards its borders.

azeroth.name: Maestra's Post
azeroth.desc: A night elf watchtower in Ashenvale. The movements of the Horde are monitored here.

azeroth.name: Astranaar
azeroth.desc: The main night elf settlement in Ashenvale. Tree houses and shrines to Elune stretch here.

azeroth.name: Shrine of Aessina
azeroth.desc: A shrine in Ashenvale dedicated to Aessina, goddess of the moon. Prayers for protection and wisdom are offered here.

azeroth.name: Stardust Spire
azeroth.desc: An ancient elven tower in Ashenvale. Its spire reaches for the stars, and ancient knowledge is kept inside.

azeroth.name: Fold
azeroth.desc: A small gorge in Ashenvale where wild beasts hide.

azeroth.name: Silverwind Refuge
azeroth.desc: A night elf refuge in Ashenvale. Travelers can find shelter and protection here.

azeroth.name: Raynewood Retreat
azeroth.desc: A night elf camp in Ashenvale hidden among ancient trees.

azeroth.name: Splintertree Post
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in Ashenvale. From here, the Horde conducts logging and patrols the territory.

azeroth.name: Forest Song
azeroth.desc: A small settlement in Ashenvale where forest spirits and druids live.

azeroth.name: Warsong Lumber Camp
azeroth.desc: A Horde lumberjack camp in Ashenvale. Timber is harvested here for the needs of the Horde.

azeroth.name: Demon Fall Canyon
azeroth.desc: A canyon in Ashenvale where, according to legend, a powerful demon fell. Its bones still lie among the rocks.

azeroth.name: Shrine of Goldrinn
azeroth.desc: A shrine in Ashenvale dedicated to Goldrinn, the ancient wolf spirit. Hunters ask for luck here.

azeroth.name: Grove of Aessina
azeroth.desc: A sacred grove in Ashenvale where Aessina is worshipped. Peace and grace reign here.

azeroth.name: Flamewake
azeroth.desc: A place in Ashenvale where an ancient flame has not gone out for thousands of years. Fire spirits dwell here.

azeroth.name: Sanctuary of Malorne
azeroth.desc: A shrine in Ashenvale dedicated to Malorne, the ancient stag spirit. Druids ask for blessings here.

azeroth.name: Sethria's Roost
azeroth.desc: A harpy lair in Ashenvale. They build nests here and guard their territory.

azeroth.name: Sulfuron Spire
azeroth.desc: An ancient tower in Ashenvale where servants of fire dwell. Its spire is visible from afar.

azeroth.name: Ascendant's Rise
azeroth.desc: A mountain peak in Ashenvale where ascendant creatures dwell. Dark magic reigns here.

azeroth.name: Gates of Sothann
azeroth.desc: Ancient gates in Ashenvale leading to sacred lands. They are guarded by nature spirits.

azeroth.name: Gallywix Pleasure Palace
azeroth.desc: The luxurious palace of Trade Prince Gallywix in Azshara. The loudest parties and most profitable deals take place here.

azeroth.name: Mountainfoot Strip Mine
azeroth.desc: An open-pit mine in Azshara where ore and stone are extracted. Goblins and hired workers toil here.

azeroth.name: Talrendis Point
azeroth.desc: A watchtower in Azshara. The coast is monitored here and borders are guarded.

azeroth.name: Orgrimmar
azeroth.desc: The capital of the Horde, carved into the rocks of Durotar. Orcs, trolls, tauren, and other peoples live here. The city is named after Orgrim Doomhammer and is a symbol of the strength and unity of the Horde.

azeroth.name: Drygulch Ravine
azeroth.desc: A canyon in Durotar where wild beasts live and bandits hide.

azeroth.name: Thunder Ridge
azeroth.desc: A mountain ridge in Durotar named after the thunderstorms. Thunder lizards live here.

azeroth.name: Southfury Watershed
azeroth.desc: A body of water in Durotar where the river overflows, creating fertile lands.

azeroth.name: Razor Hill
azeroth.desc: A hill in Durotar covered in thorny bushes. Fierce beasts live here.

azeroth.name: Tiragarde Keep
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in Durotar. Warriors are trained here and the borders of Orgrimmar are guarded.

azeroth.name: Sen'jin Village
azeroth.desc: A troll village in Durotar where the followers of Sen'jin live. Ancient traditions and customs are preserved here.

azeroth.name: Valley of Trials
azeroth.desc: A valley in Durotar where young orcs undergo their initiation rite. They prove their strength and honor here.

azeroth.name: Echo Isles
azeroth.desc: A group of islands off the coast of Durotar. Sea creatures live here and pirates hide.

azeroth.name: Fray Island
azeroth.desc: A small island off the coast of Durotar where arena battles are held. Warriors from all over Azeroth fight here.

azeroth.name: Stonetalon Peak
azeroth.desc: A mountain peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. Harpies and other creatures that do not tolerate outsiders live here.

azeroth.name: Thal'darah Overlook
azeroth.desc: An observation post in the Stonetalon Mountains offering a view of the valley.

azeroth.name: Cliffwalker Post
azeroth.desc: A watchtower in the Stonetalon Mountains where enemy movements are monitored.

azeroth.name: Sludgewerks
azeroth.desc: An industrial zone in the Stonetalon Mountains where waste is processed. The air here is saturated with stench.

azeroth.name: Thal'darah Grove
azeroth.desc: A sacred grove in the Stonetalon Mountains where druids dwell. They draw the power of nature here.

azeroth.name: Farwatcher's Glen
azeroth.desc: A plateau in the Stonetalon Mountains from which the surroundings are monitored. Hermits and trackers live here.

azeroth.name: Sun Rock Retreat
azeroth.desc: A refuge in the Stonetalon Mountains where travelers can rest and replenish supplies.

azeroth.name: Windshear Hold
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in the Stonetalon Mountains. From here, the Horde controls the mountain passes.

azeroth.name: Krom'gar Fortress
azeroth.desc: A mighty Horde fortress in the Stonetalon Mountains. Warriors are trained here and borders are guarded.

azeroth.name: Dry Hills
azeroth.desc: A hilly area in the Stonetalon Mountains covered in dry grass. Coyotes and lizards live here.

azeroth.name: Mor'shan Rampart
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in the Stonetalon Mountains. Approaches to Krom'gar Fortress are guarded here.

azeroth.name: Sludge Fen
azeroth.desc: A swamp in the Stonetalon Mountains saturated with oil and mud. Creatures accustomed to filth live here.

azeroth.name: Nozzlepot's Outpost
azeroth.desc: A goblin camp in the Stonetalon Mountains. Anything that can be sold is traded here.

azeroth.name: Northern Barrens
azeroth.desc: Vast steppes in eastern Kalimdor where nomads and wild beasts roam. Camps of tauren and orcs stretch here.

azeroth.name: Forgotten Pools
azeroth.desc: Pools in the Northern Barrens where animals and birds rest.

azeroth.name: Crossroads
azeroth.desc: A major trading hub in the Northern Barrens. The paths of caravans and travelers from all over Kalimdor intersect here.

azeroth.name: Far Watch Post
azeroth.desc: A watchtower in the Northern Barrens. Enemy movements are monitored here.

azeroth.name: Ratchet
azeroth.desc: A goblin port town in the Northern Barrens. Brisk trade takes place here, and ships depart for the shores of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

azeroth.name: Stagnant Oasis
azeroth.desc: An oasis in the Northern Barrens where the water has stagnated and become overgrown with algae. Rare creatures live here.

azeroth.name: Wailing Caverns
azeroth.desc: An underground complex in the Northern Barrens inhabited by creatures that emit blood-curdling sounds. Ancient secrets are kept here.

azeroth.name: Honor's Stand
azeroth.desc: A Horde stronghold in the Northern Barrens. Warriors are trained here and borders are guarded.

azeroth.name: Hunter's Hill
azeroth.desc: A hill in the Northern Barrens where hunters set up camps and share their catch.

azeroth.name: Overgrowth
azeroth.desc: Dense thickets in the Northern Barrens where wild beasts hide.

azeroth.name: Vendetta Point
azeroth.desc: A Horde camp in the Northern Barrens. They prepare for battles and guard the territory here.

azeroth.name: Forward Command
azeroth.desc: A forward Horde camp in the Northern Barrens. Offensives against enemy positions begin here.

azeroth.name: Ruins of Taurajo
azeroth.desc: A destroyed tauren village in the Northern Barrens. Its ruins are a reminder of a past tragedy.

azeroth.name: Great Gate
azeroth.desc: Huge gates in the Northern Barrens separating the lands of the Horde from the lands of the Alliance.

azeroth.name: Thunder Bluff
azeroth.desc: The capital of the tauren, built on the plateau of Mulgore. The tauren, who preserve the traditions of their ancestors, live here. The city is known for its totems and sanctuaries.

azeroth.name: Mulgore
azeroth.desc: A fertile valley in central Kalimdor, the home of the tauren. Endless plains and sacred sites stretch here. The tauren live in harmony with nature, worshipping the spirits.

azeroth.name: Thunderhorn Water Well
azeroth.desc: A spring in Mulgore named after the Thunderhorn tribe. Its water is considered sacred.

azeroth.name: Bael'dun Digsite
azeroth.desc: An archaeological dig site in Mulgore where dwarves study ancient artifacts.

azeroth.name: Camp Sungraze
azeroth.desc: A tauren camp in Mulgore. They raise cattle and live in peace with nature here.
