azeroth.desc: Ancient ruins in southern Zuldazar where the petrified remains of Xibala, the first devilsaur and mother of the loa Rezan, lie. The Zandalari avoid this place, as it now belongs to wild beasts.

azeroth.name: Valor's Rest
azeroth.desc: A small camp in northern Silithus that serves as a waypoint for both factions. It is home to a graveyard for fallen heroes and members of the Cenarion Circle. This place miraculously survived Sargeras's destruction of Silithus.

azeroth.name: Malaka'jin
azeroth.desc: A Horde village in the Stonetalon Mountains, located just south of the Grimtotem Post. It houses a small community of troll hunters who make a modest income by selling their catches to passing Horde adventurers. The village has a flight master and serves as the base from which the Horde launches its attacks against the Grimtotem tribe.

azeroth.name: Forbidding Sea
azeroth.desc: Cold waters in eastern Azeroth. Sunken cities and ancient monsters hide here.

azeroth.name: South Seas
azeroth.desc: Warm waters south of Azeroth where countless islands stretch. Pirate coves and sunken treasures hide here.

draenor.name: Highmaul
draenor.desc: The capital of the Gorian Empire of ogres, which once ruled all of Draenor before the arrival of the draenei. A huge city built in the desert canyons of Nagrand, it served as a symbol of the strength and cruelty of the ogres who held the planet in an iron fist.

draenor.name: Path of Victors
draenor.desc: The triumphal road leading to Highmaul. Victorious ogres paraded captured prisoners along it to demonstrate their power.

draenor.name: Gorian Strand
draenor.desc: The eastern coast of Nagrand, named after the Gorian Empire of the ogres. Ancient ruins and camps of ogres guarding their lands are located here.

draenor.name: Mok'gol Watchpost
draenor.desc: A Warsong clan stronghold in eastern Nagrand. From here, the orcs monitor the movements of Alliance forces and guard the approaches to their territories.

draenor.name: Broken Precipice
draenor.desc: The rocky coast in northeastern Nagrand. According to ancient legends, it was here that the mountain split from the blow of the titan Aggramar, giving birth to the giant Grond.

draenor.name: Nagrand
draenor.desc: A green plateau in the western part of Draenor, the home of the Warsong clan and the last bastion of ancient orc traditions. Here, huge beasts shake the earth, and wolf riders prowl in search of prey.

draenor.name: Oshu'gun
draenor.desc: A draenei city-fortress dedicated to the elements. Here, exarchs trained young warriors and seers, and ancient artifacts were kept in the halls of the temple.

draenor.name: Ironfist Harbor
draenor.desc: A port on the southwestern coast of Nagrand, serving as a transshipment point for the forces of the Iron Horde. From here, orc ships depart for the shores of Talador and beyond.

draenor.name: Ancestral Grounds
draenor.desc: The sacred lands of the Warsong clan, where the remains of great warriors of the past rest. Here, orcs perform initiation rites and honor the memory of the fallen.

draenor.name: Lok-rath
draenor.desc: A Warsong clan camp in Nagrand, named after an ancient hero. Grommash Hellscream gathers forces here to fight the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Stonecrag Gorge
draenor.desc: A deep gorge in eastern Nagrand where fierce gronn and other colossal creatures live. Dangerous paths leading to the Elemental Plateau pass through here.

draenor.name: Throne of the Elements
draenor.desc: A sacred place in northeastern Nagrand, created from the head of the fallen Grond. The four great furious spirits of Draenor dwell here, and the first orc shamans learned the art of controlling the elements here.

draenor.name: Elemental Plateau
draenor.desc: Almost a sanctuary of the elementals of Nagrand. The greatest of them are the guardians — mighty spirits protecting these lands. The disruption of natural balance has made the guardians unstable.

draenor.name: Ring of Blood
draenor.desc: An ancient ogre arena in eastern Nagrand where bloody battles take place. Here, ogres and their prisoners fight to the death for the entertainment of the public.

draenor.name: Path of the Giftgiver
draenor.desc: This location is an error, it does not lead anywhere, move on)

draenor.name: Ring of Trials
draenor.desc: A neutral arena in Nagrand where heroes from all over Azeroth and Draenor meet in friendly duels. Here you can meet a variety of NPCs and fight for glory.

draenor.name: Hallvalor
draenor.desc: An ancient hall carved into the rock. Relics and weapons of great warriors of the past are kept here, and the spirits of fallen heroes guard the peace of this place.

draenor.name: Shattrath
draenor.desc: A majestic draenei city in the very heart of Talador. Once the center of spiritual and cultural life, it is now besieged by the forces of the Iron Horde. The prison for draenei souls, Auchindoun, is located here.

draenor.name: Talador
draenor.desc: The central zone of Draenor, known in Outland as Terokkar Forest. Shattrath and Auchindoun, the sacred mausoleum of the draenei where the souls of the deceased find peace, are located here. This is the heart of draenei civilization.

draenor.name: Grommashar
draenor.desc: The Warsong clan fortress in Talador, named after Grommash Hellscream. Here, the orcs prepare for decisive battles against the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Mar'gok's Overwatch
draenor.desc: A stronghold in southern Talador, named after the orc warlord. It offers a view of the valley, and warriors monitor enemy movements here.

draenor.name: Gul'rok
draenor.desc: A camp in southern Talador, named after an ancient hero. Orcs loyal to the traditions of their ancestors gather here and prepare to defend their lands.

draenor.name: Telaar
draenor.desc: A small draenei settlement in southern Talador. Farmers and artisans preserving the traditions of their ancient civilization live here.

draenor.name: Court of Souls
draenor.desc: A grim place in Talador where spirits that have not found peace dwell. Silence reigns here, and the air is saturated with the emanations of death.

draenor.name: Tomb of Lights
draenor.desc: A sacred draenei tomb where the remains of great exarchs rest. Ancient relics and artifacts possessing enormous power are kept here.

draenor.name: Auchindoun
draenor.desc: The sacred mausoleum of the draenei in Talador, where the souls of the deceased rest. Auchenai priests guard the countless souls within, protecting them from the demonic threat.

draenor.name: Telmor
draenor.desc: An ancient draenei city in Talador, destroyed during the war. Its ruins remember the times before the arrival of the Iron Horde and preserve the memory of the fallen.

draenor.name: Gordal Fortress
draenor.desc: A mighty Iron Horde fortress in southern Talador. The forces of the Iron Orcs are concentrated here, preparing for an offensive on Shattrath.

draenor.name: Tuurem
draenor.desc: A peaceful draenei settlement in northeastern Talador. Here you can take a break from the noise and bustle of the big city and enjoy the silence.

draenor.name: Vol'jin's Pride
draenor.desc: A Horde stronghold in eastern Talador. From here, the Horde conducts reconnaissance and prepares for battles against the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Aruuna
draenor.desc: A small village in eastern Talador. Peaceful inhabitants live here, trying to survive in wartime conditions and preserve their traditions.

draenor.name: Fort Wrynn
draenor.desc: An Alliance stronghold in northern Talador, named after King Varian Wrynn. From here, Alliance forces coordinate their actions against the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Orunai Coast
draenor.desc: A picturesque coast in eastern Talador. Fishing villages and ancient ruins are located here, and Iron Horde forces have also landed.

draenor.name: Draenor
draenor.desc: A harsh world, the home of the orcs and the last refuge of the draenei. This is an alternate version of Draenor before its destruction, described in the Warlords of Draenor expansion.

draenor.name: South Sea
draenor.desc: Warm waters washing the southern coast of Draenor. Trade routes pass through here and pirates hide, and monsters of the depths live underwater.

draenor.name: Spires of Arak
draenor.desc: The southernmost part of Draenor, a zone of soaring heights and shadow-shrouded rocks. The arakkoa — proud bird-people — live here, and their capital, Skyreach, floats in the clouds.

draenor.name: Bladefist Hold
draenor.desc: A grim fortress of the Shattered Hand clan in the Spires of Arak. Kargath Bladefist rules here, preparing his forces for the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Skettis
draenor.desc: An ancient arakkoa city in the Spires of Arak, now lying in ruins. Exiled arakkoa live here, and the air is saturated with the magic of the past.

draenor.name: Veil Akraz
draenor.desc: One of the settlements of arakkoa outcasts, scorched by the rays of the Skyreach weapon. Survivors try to rebuild their lives among the ruins here.

draenor.name: Axefall
draenor.desc: A Shattered Hand clan camp in southern Spires of Arak. Orc outcasts prepare for battles and guard their territories here.

draenor.name: Writhing Mire
draenor.desc: A grim swamp in the Spires of Arak where disgusting creatures live. A stench reigns here, and the water is saturated with dark magic.

draenor.name: Southport
draenor.desc: A port on the southern coast of the Spires of Arak, serving as a transshipment point for Alliance forces. Ships take shelter from storms and replenish supplies here.

draenor.name: Bloodmane Valley
draenor.desc: A valley in the Spires of Arak where fierce saberon live. They hunt here and guard their territory from outsiders.

draenor.name: Veil Zekk
draenor.desc: A settlement of arakkoa outcasts in the Spires of Arak. They live in exile here, trying to survive in the harsh mountain conditions.

draenor.name: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
draenor.desc: A mechanical workshop of goblins in the Spires of Arak. Machinery is repaired here and weapons are produced to fight the arakkoa and the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Pinchwhistle Point
draenor.desc: A cape on the southeastern coast of the Spires of Arak where a goblin camp is located. It offers a view of the ocean and passing ships.

draenor.name: Sethekk Hollow
draenor.desc: A deep gorge in the Spires of Arak where exiled arakkoa live. Eternal twilight reigns here, and the rocks are covered with ancient runes.

draenor.name: Howling Crag
draenor.desc: A lonely cliff in the northeastern Spires of Arak where the wind makes blood-curdling sounds. Rare birds nest here and mountain spirits dwell.

draenor.name: Frostfire Ridge
draenor.desc: The Horde starting zone in Draenor, a land of endless winter. Snow-covered wastelands alternate with active volcanoes, and the Frostwolf clan fights for its homeland.

draenor.name: Wor'gol
draenor.desc: A Frostwolf clan camp in southern Frostfire Ridge. Warriors rest and prepare for battles here, and the air smells of smoke and meat.

draenor.name: Bladespire Citadel
draenor.desc: A mighty ogre fortress in southern Frostfire Ridge. Its walls have withstood sieges for centuries, and treasures of ancient empires are kept inside.

draenor.name: Stonefang Outpost
draenor.desc: A stronghold in southeastern Frostfire Ridge where Horde warriors serve. From here, they monitor the movements of ogres and the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Frostwall
draenor.desc: The Horde citadel in Frostfire Ridge, built by the forces of the Frostwolf clan. Here players develop their garrison and gather an army to fight the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Grom'gar
draenor.desc: A city built on the bones of fallen giants. Frostwolf clan orcs live here, and the city itself serves as a symbol of strength and unity.

draenor.name: Daggermaw Ravine
draenor.desc: A deep gorge in eastern Frostfire Ridge where fierce predators live. The foot of a living being rarely steps here, and the air smells of blood.

draenor.name: Cracking Plains
draenor.desc: A vast icy wasteland in the central part of Frostfire Ridge. Piercing winds blow here, and the earth is covered with cracks and permafrost.

draenor.name: Colossal's Fall
draenor.desc: The site of the death of a huge colossus, whose remains still lie in northern Frostfire Ridge. The giant's bones have become part of the landscape, and rare plants grow around them.

draenor.name: Magnarok
draenor.desc: An ancient altar or place of power in Frostfire Ridge. Ancestral spirits dwell here, and shamans perform their rituals, calling upon the forces of nature.

draenor.name: Zangar Sea
draenor.desc: An inland sea in northwestern Draenor. Its waters wash the shores of several zones, and sunken cities and ancient monsters hide at the bottom.

draenor.name: Iron Sea
draenor.desc: A cold sea in northwestern Draenor, washing the shores of Frostfire Ridge and Gorgrond. Icebergs float here, and monsters of the depths hide underwater.

draenor.name: Shadowmoon Valley
draenor.desc: The Alliance starting zone in Draenor, stretching under the cover of eternal night. The majestic Karabor temple is located here, and dark forces of the Shadowmoon clan hide in the forests.

draenor.name: Darktide Roost
draenor.desc: A lair of dark creatures in Shadowmoon Valley. Servants of Gul'dan live here, and the air is saturated with fel and dark magic.

draenor.name: Socrethar's Rise
draenor.desc: A height in Shadowmoon Valley named after Socrethar. Ancient ruins and draenei camps guarding their lands are located here.

draenor.name: Shimmer Moor
draenor.desc: A swampy area in Shadowmoon Valley where the water shimmers under the starlight. Rare creatures live here, and the air is filled with silence.

draenor.name: Shaz'gul
draenor.desc: A grim place in Shadowmoon Valley where dark spirits dwell. Forbidden rituals are performed here, and the earth is saturated with necrotic energy.

draenor.name: Burial Fields
draenor.desc: Sacred fields in Shadowmoon Valley where the draenei bury their dead. Silence reigns here, and the tombstones preserve the memory of fallen heroes.

draenor.name: Karabor
draenor.desc: A majestic draenei temple-tomb in Shadowmoon Valley. Ancient knowledge and artifacts are kept here, and the temple itself serves as a spiritual center for all draenei of Draenor.

draenor.name: Elodor
draenor.desc: A draenei city in Shadowmoon Valley where the revered Altar of Sha'tar is located. Great exarchs live here, and the city serves as a symbol of the prosperity of draenei civilization.

draenor.name: Embaari Village
draenor.desc: A trading town in Shadowmoon Valley. You can buy everything you need here, and locals are happy to see guests and share the latest news.

draenor.name: Anguish Fortress
draenor.desc: A grim fortress in Shadowmoon Valley where demons and their servants live. Darkness reigns here, and the air is saturated with suffering and pain.

draenor.name: Lunarfall
draenor.desc: The Alliance citadel in Shadowmoon Valley, built by the forces of the draenei and their allies. Here players develop their garrison and gather an army to fight the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Gloomshade Grove
draenor.desc: A dark grove in Shadowmoon Valley where trees are covered in shadow. Spirits that have not found peace dwell here, and the air is filled with silence and sorrow.

draenor.name: Gul'var
draenor.desc: A camp in southern Shadowmoon Valley, named after Gul'dan. Dark shamans and warlocks ready to serve the Legion gather here.

draenor.name: Evanescent Sea
draenor.desc: A sea in southeastern Draenor, washing the shores of Shadowmoon Valley and Talador. Its waters seem ghostly, and sunken cities hide beneath the surface.

draenor.name: Ashran
draenor.desc: A PvP zone in southern Draenor where the forces of the Alliance and Horde fight for control over the island. Military facilities and camps of both factions are located here.

draenor.name: Warspear
draenor.desc: The main Horde stronghold in Ashran. Horde forces build siege engines and prepare for battles against the Alliance here.

draenor.name: Amphitheater of Annihilation
draenor.desc: A huge arena in Ashran where mass battles take place. Alliance and Horde forces fight here for control over the territory.

draenor.name: Brute's Rise
draenor.desc: A rocky cliff in Ashran where ogre brutes live. They guard their territories and prepare for raids here.

draenor.name: Dark Woods
draenor.desc: A grim forest in Ashran where trees are covered in shadow. Rare creatures live here, and the air is saturated with dampness and silence.

draenor.name: Seat of Kor'lok
draenor.desc: An ancient throne in Ashran where the powerful ogre Kor'lok sits. The fate of the island is decided here, and his power instills fear in enemies.

draenor.name: Molten Quarry
draenor.desc: A quarry in Ashran where molten rocks are mined. Workers and their overseers toil here, and the air is saturated with heat and dust.

draenor.name: Stormshield
draenor.desc: The main Alliance stronghold in Ashran. Alliance forces build siege engines and prepare for battles against the Horde here.

draenor.name: Ashmaul Burial Grounds
draenor.desc: An ancient ogre cemetery in Ashran where the remains of great warriors rest. A grim atmosphere reigns here, and the tombstones preserve the memory of the past.

draenor.name: Ring of Conquest
draenor.desc: An ancient arena in Ashran where ogres hold tournaments. Warriors from all over Draenor fight here, and winners receive glory and wealth.

draenor.name: Barrier Sea
draenor.desc: A sea in eastern Draenor, washing the shores of Ashran. Its waters are cold and dangerous, and reefs and monsters hide beneath the surface.

draenor.name: Tanaan Jungle
draenor.desc: Dense jungles in eastern Draenor, home to the Bleeding Hollow clan. The Dark Portal is located here, and Iron Horde forces prepare to invade Azeroth.

draenor.name: Dark Portal
draenor.desc: A magical portal in Tanaan Jungle connecting Draenor and Azeroth. Through it, the Iron Horde plans to invade Azeroth and destroy it.

draenor.name: Vol'mar
draenor.desc: A camp in southern Tanaan Jungle where orcs of the Bleeding Hollow clan live. They perform their rituals and prepare for battles here.

draenor.name: Lion's Watch
draenor.desc: An Alliance stronghold in Tanaan Jungle. From here, Alliance forces monitor the movements of the Iron Horde and guard the approaches to the Dark Portal.

draenor.name: Fang'rila
draenor.desc: A coast in Tanaan Jungle where fierce creatures live. Wild nature reigns here, and the air smells of the sea and blood.

draenor.name: Throne of Kil'jaeden
draenor.desc: An ancient throne in Tanaan Jungle where Kil'jaeden once sat. Dark artifacts are kept here, and the air is saturated with fel.

draenor.name: Fel Forge
draenor.desc: A grim forge in Tanaan Jungle where demons forge weapons and armor. Heat reigns here, and the air smells of sulfur.

draenor.name: Hellfire Citadel
draenor.desc: A mighty Iron Horde fortress in Tanaan Jungle. The strongest warriors and warlords live here, and its walls have seen many battles.

draenor.name: Ironhold Harbor
draenor.desc: A port in northeastern Tanaan Jungle serving as a base for the Iron Horde fleet. From here, orc ships depart for the shores of Azeroth.

draenor.name: Ruins of Kra'nak
draenor.desc: Ancient ruins in Tanaan Jungle left from a fallen civilization. Their stones remember the times before the arrival of the Iron Horde.

draenor.name: Zeth'Gol
draenor.desc: A camp in southern Tanaan Jungle where dark shamans live. Rituals are performed here, and the air is saturated with necrotic energy.

draenor.name: Iron Front
draenor.desc: The Iron Horde defense line in Tanaan Jungle. The main forces of the orcs, ready to repel any attack, are concentrated here.

draenor.name: Temple of Sha'naar
draenor.desc: An ancient draenei temple in Tanaan Jungle dedicated to the Light. Sacred relics are kept here, and its halls are full of silence and peace.

draenor.name: Zangarra
draenor.desc: A small settlement in southern Tanaan Jungle. Peaceful inhabitants live here, trying to survive in wartime conditions and preserve their traditions.

draenor.name: Gorgrond
draenor.desc: A zone in north-central Draenor, a land of giants where an eternal struggle between creation and destruction takes place. The Iron Horde armories and the Blackrock clan lair are located here.

draenor.name: Iron Docks
draenor.desc: A port and military complex of the Iron Horde in Gorgrond. Ships and siege engines are built here, and an army is prepared for the invasion of Azeroth.

draenor.name: The Pit
draenor.desc: A huge pit in Gorgrond where the most dangerous predators live. Bloody battles are held here, and the air smells of death.

draenor.name: Blackrock Foundry
draenor.desc: A huge industrial complex of the Blackrock clan in Gorgrond. Weapons and armor for the Iron Horde are forged here, and the air is saturated with smoke and heat.

draenor.name: Everbloom Wilds
draenor.desc: Lush jungles in Gorgrond where the botani — intelligent half-plants spreading their wild flora — live. Lush vegetation reigns here, and the air is saturated with life force.

draenor.name: Gronn Canyon
draenor.desc: A desert canyon in Gorgrond teeming with dangerous monsters. Gronn and other giant creatures live here, and the air is saturated with dust and heat.

draenor.name: Highpass
draenor.desc: A mountain path in Gorgrond leading to the peaks. Travelers can take a shortcut here, but dangers such as predators and rockfalls lurk.

draenor.name: Tangleheart
draenor.desc: A corner of lush jungles in Gorgrond where the botani cultivate new ancients. Lush vegetation reigns here, and trees intertwine into impenetrable thickets.

draenor.name: Beastwatch
draenor.desc: A stronghold in Gorgrond where wild beasts are monitored. Hunters and trackers study the habits of local predators and guard the borders here.

draenor.name: Stonemaul Arena
draenor.desc: An ancient ogre arena in Gorgrond where bloody battles take place. Warriors from all over Draenor fight here, and winners receive glory and wealth.

draenor.name: Evermorn Springs
draenor.desc: Thermal springs in Gorgrond surrounded by lush vegetation. Animals rest here and travelers warm up, and the water has healing properties.

draenor.name: Bastion Rise
draenor.desc: A rocky cliff in Gorgrond offering a view of the surroundings. An observation post monitoring enemy movements is located here.

draenor.name: Iron Siegeworks
draenor.desc: A Horde military camp in Gorgrond where siege engines are built. From here, Horde forces prepare for an offensive against Iron Horde positions.

outland.name: Outland
outland.desc: A fragment of the shattered Draenor, floating in the Twisting Nether after Gul'dan tore the world apart. Scorched wastelands, floating rocks, and lands saturated with fel stretch here. Outland is a battleground between the forces of Illidan, the Legion, and the remnants of draenei civilization.

outland.name: Nagrand
outland.desc: A green plateau floating in the void of Outland. The surviving orcs of the Mag'har clan and the draenei live here. The land is rich in game, and the sacred mountain Oshu'gun rises in the center.

outland.name: Oshu'gun
outland.desc: The sacred mountain of the draenei, where, according to legend, their dimensional ship landed. A dark entity dwells here, and ancient naaru crystals are hidden inside the mountain. A place of pilgrimage and sorrow.

outland.name: The Twilight Ridge
outland.desc: A mountain ridge in Nagrand shrouded in eternal twilight. Dragons of the Twilight flight and their servants hide here, and the air is saturated with dark magic.

outland.name: Forge Camp: Fear
outland.desc: One of the Burning Legion camps in Nagrand. Demons perform their rituals and prepare for attacks here.

outland.name: Forge Camp: Hate
outland.desc: The second Burning Legion camp in Nagrand. Demons and their minions, ready for attacks, live here.

outland.name: Sunspring Post
outland.desc: An orc settlement in Nagrand built around a healing spring. Mag'har clans loyal to the traditions of their ancestors live here.

outland.name: Halaa
outland.desc: A city-fortress in southern Nagrand constantly fought over by the Alliance and Horde. Ruins of ancient fortifications and titan relics are located here.

outland.name: Warmaul Hill
outland.desc: A height in western Nagrand where ogres of the Warmaul clan live. They guard their treasures and prisoners here.

outland.name: Laughing Skull Ruins
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in southern Nagrand left by the Laughing Skull clan. Spirits of fallen warriors dwell here.

outland.name: Garadar
outland.desc: The main settlement of the Mag'har clan in Nagrand. Greatmother Geyah rules here, and its inhabitants preserve the traditions of their ancestors and resist the fel.

outland.name: Throne of the Elements
outland.desc: A sacred place in northeastern Nagrand where four great elementals live. Orc shamans communicate with the spirits of the elements here.

outland.name: Telaar
outland.desc: The main draenei city in Nagrand. Peaceful farmers live here, and an Alliance camp for fighting the Legion is also located here.

outland.name: The Ring of Trials
outland.desc: An ancient arena in southeastern Nagrand where Mag'har orcs perform initiation rites. Warriors fight here, proving their honor.

outland.name: Kil'sorrow Fortress
outland.desc: A grim fortress in southeastern Nagrand where orcs of the Kil'sorrow clan, serving the Legion, live. Dark rituals are performed here.

outland.name: Burning Blade Ruins
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in eastern Nagrand where orcs of the Burning Blade clan live. They worship demons here.

outland.name: Shattrath City
outland.desc: An ancient draenei city stretching across the Terokkar Forest. Once a spiritual center, now a neutral city where refugees and the forces of the Aldor and Scryers take shelter.

outland.name: Bleeding Hollow Ruins
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in southern Terokkar Forest left by the Bleeding Hollow clan. Orcs serving Illidan live here.

outland.name: Bone Wastes
outland.desc: A vast wasteland in southern Terokkar Forest strewn with the bones of the fallen. The ruins of Auchindoun and adventurer camps stretch here.

outland.name: Auchindoun
outland.desc: The sacred mausoleum of the draenei in the Bone Wastes. The souls of the deceased rest here, and ancient crypts and dark forces are hidden inside.

outland.name: Stonebreaker Hold
outland.desc: A Horde stronghold in northern Terokkar Forest. From here, the Horde conducts reconnaissance and prepares for battles against the Legion and the Scourge.

outland.name: Allerian Stronghold
outland.desc: An Alliance stronghold in eastern Terokkar Forest, named after Alleria Windrunner. Elves and humans fighting the forces of Illidan take shelter here.

outland.name: Bonechewer Ruins
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in eastern Terokkar Forest where orcs of the Bonechewer clan live. They guard their territories here.

outland.name: Tuurem
outland.desc: A small draenei settlement in eastern Terokkar Forest, now lying in ruins after an orc attack. Ghosts of the past dwell here.

outland.name: Firewing Point
outland.desc: A blood elf camp in eastern Terokkar Forest. They study magic and protect their interests in Outland here.

outland.name: Cenarion Thicket
outland.desc: A small forest in Terokkar Forest where Cenarion druids live. They protect nature and investigate anomalies here.

outland.name: Terokkar Forest
outland.desc: A vast forest in southern Outland, once part of Terokkar. Ancient ruins stretch here, as well as the lands of Shattrath and Auchindoun.

outland.name: Zangarmarsh
outland.desc: A huge swamp in northwestern Outland, famous for its giant mushrooms and glowing waters. Sporelings, draenei, and naga live here.

outland.name: Spawning Glen
outland.desc: A small glade in Zangarmarsh overgrown with giant mushrooms. Sporelings perform their rituals here.

outland.name: Sporeggar
outland.desc: A sporeling settlement in Zangarmarsh. Peaceful mushroom-people live here, trading with travelers and guarding their lands.

outland.name: Marshlight Lake
outland.desc: A large lake in Zangarmarsh whose waters glow in the dark. Rare creatures live here and glowing mushrooms grow.

outland.name: Zabra'jin
outland.desc: A village of Zandalari trolls in Zangarmarsh. Hunters and shamans guarding their traditions live here.

outland.name: Twin Spire Ruins
outland.desc: Ancient elven ruins in Zangarmarsh left from two towers. Naga live here and ancient secrets hide.

outland.name: Serpent Lake
outland.desc: A lake in central Zangarmarsh where naga from the Coilfang Reservoir live. Its waters are dark and dangerous.

outland.name: Coilfang Reservoir
outland.desc: A huge underground naga complex in Zangarmarsh, filled with water and magic. The most dangerous servants of Lady Vashj hide here.

outland.name: Lagoon
outland.desc: A small lagoon in eastern Zangarmarsh. Travelers rest here and rare aquatic creatures live.

outland.name: Ango'rosh Grounds
outland.desc: Swampy lands in western Zangarmarsh where ogres of the Ango'rosh clan live. They build their camps and guard their territories here.

outland.name: Telredor
outland.desc: A draenei city in northern Zangarmarsh, built on a giant mushroom. Peaceful draenei live here and trade is conducted.

outland.name: Umbrafen Lake
outland.desc: A large lake in eastern Zangarmarsh surrounded by dense thickets. Dangerous creatures live here and hermits hide.

outland.name: Cenarion Refuge
outland.desc: A Cenarion druid stronghold in Zangarmarsh. They study the ecology of the marshes and protect nature from the fel here.

outland.name: Swamprat Post
outland.desc: A Horde stronghold in eastern Zangarmarsh, named after the 'Swamprat' squad. From here, the Horde conducts reconnaissance.

outland.name: Dead Mire
outland.desc: A grim swamp in eastern Zangarmarsh saturated with fel. Sick creatures live here and desolation reigns.

outland.name: Shadowmoon Valley
outland.desc: A grim valley in southeastern Outland shrouded in eternal twilight. The Black Temple and Illidan's citadel are located here, and the land is saturated with fel.

outland.name: Netherwing Ledge
outland.desc: A mountain ridge in southern Shadowmoon Valley where Netherwing dragons live. They lay eggs and guard their nests here.

outland.name: Black Temple
outland.desc: A huge citadel in Shadowmoon Valley, once a draenei temple, now the throne of Illidan Stormrage. His loyal servants and demons live here.

outland.name: Dragonmaw Fortress
outland.desc: A Dragonmaw clan orc stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley. They enslave dragons and prepare for battles here.

outland.name: Altar of Sha'tar
outland.desc: A sacred draenei altar in Shadowmoon Valley where prayers for the Light are offered. Pilgrims and priests gather here.

outland.name: Coilskar Point
outland.desc: A naga camp in Shadowmoon Valley. They serve Illidan and guard his domains here.

outland.name: Hand of Gul'dan
outland.desc: A grim place in Shadowmoon Valley where, according to legend, Gul'dan was torn apart by demons. His dark energy is still felt here.

outland.name: Warden's Cage
outland.desc: A prison in Shadowmoon Valley where Illidan's prisoners are kept. Wardens — loyal servants of the dark lord — serve here.

outland.name: Sanctum of the Stars
outland.desc: An ancient draenei sanctuary in Shadowmoon Valley. Knowledge about the stars and their influence on magic is kept here.

outland.name: Eclipse Point
outland.desc: A blood elf camp in Shadowmoon Valley. They study solar magic and protect their interests here.

outland.name: Wildhammer Stronghold
outland.desc: A Wildhammer clan dwarven stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley. They fight the forces of Illidan and the Legion here.

outland.name: Skettis
outland.desc: An ancient arakkoa city in southeastern Outland, floating in the skies. They worship dark forces and guard their treasures here.

outland.name: Illidari Point
outland.desc: An Illidari camp in Shadowmoon Valley. They prepare for battles with the Legion and guard Illidan's domains here.

outland.name: Legion Hold
outland.desc: A Burning Legion stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley. Demons and their servants, preparing for invasion, live here.

outland.name: Shadowmoon Village
outland.desc: An orc settlement in Shadowmoon Valley loyal to Illidan. Warriors and shamans preserving dark traditions live here.

outland.name: Deathforge
outland.desc: A grim industrial complex in Shadowmoon Valley where demons forge weapons. Heat and the smell of sulfur reign here.

outland.name: Hellfire Peninsula
outland.desc: A scorched peninsula in northeastern Outland where Alliance and Horde forces have landed. The Dark Portal is located here, and the land is saturated with fel.

outland.name: Dark Portal
outland.desc: A magical portal in Hellfire Peninsula connecting Outland and Azeroth. Hordes once poured through it, and now heroes pass through it.

outland.name: Throne of Kil'jaeden
outland.desc: An ancient throne in Hellfire Peninsula where Kil'jaeden sat. His dark power is still felt here.

outland.name: Legion Front
outland.desc: The frontline of the Burning Legion in Hellfire Peninsula. Continuous battles with the forces of the Alliance and Horde take place here.

outland.name: Zeth'Gor
outland.desc: An orc fortress in Hellfire Peninsula, now captured by the Legion. Demons and their servants live here.

outland.name: Expedition Armory
outland.desc: The Alliance armory in Hellfire Peninsula, now lying in ruins after a Legion attack. Ghosts of fallen soldiers dwell here.

outland.name: Honor Hold
outland.desc: The main Alliance stronghold in Hellfire Peninsula. From here, Alliance forces fight the Legion and the Scourge.

outland.name: Thrallmar
outland.desc: The main Horde stronghold in Hellfire Peninsula, named after Thrall. From here, the Horde advances against the Legion.

outland.name: Hellfire Citadel
outland.desc: A mighty fortress in the center of Hellfire Peninsula, the citadel of the Burning Legion. Powerful demons and their servants live here.

outland.name: Pools of Aggonar
outland.desc: Grim pools in Hellfire Peninsula filled with poisoned water. Fel-corrupted monsters live here.

outland.name: Mag'har Post
outland.desc: A Mag'har clan stronghold in Hellfire Peninsula. Orcs who rejected the fel fight the Legion here.

outland.name: Temple of Telhamat
outland.desc: An ancient draenei temple in Hellfire Peninsula. Prayers for the Light are offered here and ancient relics are kept.

outland.name: Ruins of Sha'naar
outland.desc: Ancient ruins of a draenei city in Hellfire Peninsula. Spirits live here and dark forces hide.

outland.name: Falcon Watch
outland.desc: A blood elf stronghold in Hellfire Peninsula. From here, they monitor Legion movements and guard their lands.

outland.name: Den of Haal'esh
outland.desc: A grim lair in Hellfire Peninsula where Legion minions live. Dark rituals are performed here.

outland.name: Blade's Edge Mountains
outland.desc: A mountainous region in central Outland, famous for its sharp rocks and floating islands. Ogres, arakkoa, and dragons live here.

outland.name: Orebor Harborage
outland.desc: A draenei refuge in Blade's Edge Mountains. Travelers can rest and replenish supplies here, as well as get quests.

outland.name: Forge Camp: Terror
outland.desc: One of the Burning Legion camps in Blade's Edge Mountains. Demons perform their rituals and prepare for attacks here.

outland.name: Ogri'la
outland.desc: An ogre town in Blade's Edge Mountains, living in peace and trading with travelers. Mages and inventors live here.

outland.name: Forge Camp: Wrath
outland.desc: One of the Burning Legion camps in Blade's Edge Mountains. Demons perform their rituals and prepare for attacks here.

outland.name: Bloodmaul Outpost
outland.desc: A Bloodmaul clan ogre stronghold in Blade's Edge Mountains. They guard their lands and prepare for raids here.

outland.name: Sylvanaar
outland.desc: A blood elf city in Blade's Edge Mountains, built on the branches of giant trees. They guard their lands and study magic here.

outland.name: Thunderlord Stronghold
outland.desc: A Horde stronghold in Blade's Edge Mountains belonging to the Thunderlord clan. From here, the Horde conducts reconnaissance and guards its territories.

outland.name: Death's Door
outland.desc: A grim gorge in Blade's Edge Mountains leading to the lands of the Scourge. Servants of the Lich King and the undead live here.

outland.name: Vekhaar Stand
outland.desc: A forest area in Blade's Edge Mountains where arakkoa and other creatures live. Rare beasts and hermits can be found here.

outland.name: Bladespire Hold
outland.desc: A Bladespire clan ogre stronghold in Blade's Edge Mountains. They guard their treasures and prepare for battles here.

outland.name: Circle of Blood
outland.desc: An ancient ogre arena in Blade's Edge Mountains where bloody battles take place. Warriors from all over Outland fight here.

outland.name: Raven's Wood
outland.desc: A dense forest in northern Blade's Edge Mountains where arakkoa and other creatures live. Ancient trees grow here and secrets hide.

outland.name: Grishnath
outland.desc: An arakkoa nesting ground in Blade's Edge Mountains. They build their nests and guard their offspring here.

outland.name: Mok'Nathal Village
outland.desc: A village of half-orcs in Blade's Edge Mountains. The Mok'Nathal — descendants of orcs and ogres — live here, preserving the traditions of their ancestors.

outland.name: Cave of the Giftgiver
outland.desc: This location does not lead anywhere, move on)

outland.name: Bash'ir Landing
outland.desc: An ethereal camp in Blade's Edge Mountains. They trade and exchange rare artifacts here.

outland.name: Crystal Spine
outland.desc: A mountain ridge in Blade's Edge Mountains dotted with crystals. Rare creatures live here and ancient secrets hide.

outland.name: Gruul's Lair
outland.desc: The lair of Gruul, the mighty gronn lord in Blade's Edge Mountains. His sons and loyal servants live here.

outland.name: Veil Ruuan
outland.desc: An ancient arakkoa nesting ground in Blade's Edge Mountains. They guard their shrines and offspring here.

outland.name: Ruuan Weald
outland.desc: A dense forest in Blade's Edge Mountains where arakkoa and druids live. Lush vegetation reigns here and rare creatures live.

outland.name: Forge Camp: Anger
outland.desc: One of the Burning Legion camps in Blade's Edge Mountains. Demons perform their rituals and prepare for attacks here.

outland.name: Netherstorm
outland.desc: A magical wasteland in northeastern Outland, torn apart by the energy of the Nether. Islands float here, and the land is saturated with magic.

outland.name: Tempest Keep
outland.desc: A huge naaru citadel in Netherstorm, floating in the skies. Powerful creatures live here and ancient artifacts hide.

outland.name: Manaforge Duro
outland.desc: A magical forge of the blood elves in Netherstorm. They process mana and create artifacts here.

outland.name: Sunfury Hold
outland.desc: A blood elf stronghold in Netherstorm. They guard their magical domains and prepare for battles here.

outland.name: Manaforge Coruu
outland.desc: A magical forge of the blood elves in Netherstorm. They process mana and create artifacts here.

outland.name: Kirin'Var Village
outland.desc: A village of Kirin Tor mages in Netherstorm, now lying in ruins after a blood elf attack. Ghosts of fallen mages dwell here.

outland.name: Celestial Ridge
outland.desc: A mountain ridge in Netherstorm, floating in the skies. Rare creatures live here and ancient secrets hide.

outland.name: Manaforge Ultris
outland.desc: A magical forge of the blood elves in Netherstorm. They process mana and create artifacts here.

outland.name: Ruins of Farahlon
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in Netherstorm left from a civilization destroyed by the Cataclysm. Spirits of the past dwell here.

outland.name: Stormspire
outland.desc: A city of ethereals in Netherstorm, floating in the skies. They trade and exchange rare artifacts here.

outland.name: Forge Base: Gehenna
outland.desc: A Burning Legion base in Netherstorm. Demons perform their rituals and prepare for invasion here.

outland.name: Forge Base: Oblivion
outland.desc: A Burning Legion base in Netherstorm. Demons perform their rituals and prepare for invasion here.

outland.name: Manaforge Ara
outland.desc: A magical forge of the blood elves in Netherstorm. They process mana and create artifacts here.

outland.name: Eco-Dome Midrealm
outland.desc: A dome preserve in Netherstorm where life has been preserved. Rare plants and animals saved from the destruction of the world live here.

outland.name: Arklon Ruins
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in Netherstorm left from an ethereal civilization. Spirits of the past dwell here.

outland.name: Area 52
outland.desc: A secret goblin base in Netherstorm. They conduct experiments and develop new technologies here.

outland.name: Ruins of Enkaat
outland.desc: Ancient ruins in Netherstorm left from an ethereal civilization. Spirits of the past dwell here.

outland.name: Manaforge B'naar
outland.desc: A magical forge of the blood elves in Netherstorm. They process mana and create artifacts here.

outland.name: Twisting Nether
outland.desc: The inter-dimensional void surrounding Outland. Fragments of worlds float here, and the magic of the Nether distorts reality.

argus.name: Argus
argus.desc: The ancient world of the eredar, the cradle of their civilization, ravaged by the Burning Legion. Today Argus is a distorted planet floating in the Twisting Nether, with the Burning Throne at its very heart.

argus.name: Mac'Aree
argus.desc: The ancient city of the eredar, once the center of their civilization. The Ruins of Oronaar, the Seat of the Triumvirate, and the Conservatory of the Arcane are located here. Today Mac'Aree is captured by the forces of the Legion.

argus.name: Conservatory of the Arcane
argus.desc: An ancient repository of eredar knowledge where arcane magic was studied. Today its halls are defiled by the Legion, but still hold the secrets of the past.

argus.name: Triumvirate's End
argus.desc: The place where the eredar triumvirate — Kil'jaeden, Archimonde, and Velen — made fateful decisions. Today fel and desolation reign here.

argus.name: Ruins of Oronaar
argus.desc: The ancient ruins of an eredar civilization destroyed during the Legion invasion. Demons live here and spirits of the past wander.

argus.name: Seat of the Triumvirate
argus.desc: The ancient palace of the eredar triumvirate, now a dungeon captured by the forces of the Legion. Dark secrets and powerful artifacts are kept here.

argus.name: Shadowguard Incursion
argus.desc: The camp of the Shadowguard — elite servants of the Legion who have invaded Mac'Aree. They perform rituals and prepare for attacks on the forces of the Light here.

argus.name: Krokuun
argus.desc: A scorched wasteland on the surface of Argus, home to the krokul — broken eredar. The forces of the Army of the Light landed here to begin the liberation of the planet.

argus.name: Petrified Forest
argus.desc: A forest turned to stone after the death of the world. Distorted creatures live here, and the air is saturated with fel.

argus.name: Krokul Hovel
argus.desc: A settlement of the krokul — eredar twisted by the Legion. They try to survive in the harsh conditions of Argus and preserve the remnants of ancient traditions here.

argus.name: Annihilan Pits
argus.desc: The lair of the annihilan — demonic destroyers serving the Legion. They guard their domains and prepare for battles here.

argus.name: Nath'raxas Hold
argus.desc: A grim fortress in Krokuun where servants of the Legion live. Prisoners are kept here and dark rituals are performed.

argus.name: Xenedar
argus.desc: The naaru dimensional ship that crashed on Argus. Today it is a stronghold of the Army of the Light and a refuge for heroes fighting the Legion.

argus.name: Antoran Wastes
argus.desc: A scorched desert on the surface of Argus where Antorus, the Burning Throne, is located. The main forces of the Legion and their monstrous machines are concentrated here.

argus.name: Terminus
argus.desc: A transshipment point in the Antoran Wastes where the forces of the Army of the Light landed. The offensive against Antorus begins here.

argus.name: Hope's Landing
argus.desc: The beachhead of the Army of the Light in the Antoran Wastes. From here, heroes begin the assault on the Burning Throne and the liberation of Argus.

argus.name: Felfire Armory
argus.desc: The Legion's arsenal where weapons and armor for demons are forged. Heat reigns here, and the air smells of sulfur and fel.

argus.name: Spirit Crucible
argus.desc: A grim place where the Legion reforges the souls of prisoners into weapons and power. Darkness reigns here, and the air is full of suffering.

argus.name: Antorus, the Burning Throne
argus.desc: The Legion's citadel and the throne room of Sargeras. The heart of the Burning Legion and the portal through which demons invade worlds are located here. One of the most dangerous places in the universe.

shadowlands.name: Shadowlands
shadowlands.desc: The afterlife of Azeroth, where the souls of mortals go. It consists of several realms: Bastion, Ardenweald, Maldraxxus, Revendreth, and the Maw, as well as the connecting city of Oribos.

shadowlands.name: Oribos
shadowlands.desc: The ancient crossroads city of the Shadowlands, floating between realms. The Arbiter of souls is located here, as well as the servants of the First Ones who direct souls to their proper afterlives.

shadowlands.name: Bastion
shadowlands.desc: The celestial realm of the Kyrian, servants of Death who guide souls to the afterlife and protect it. Temples and citadels float here, and armor and weapons are forged in the Eternal Forge.

shadowlands.name: Citadel of Loyalty
shadowlands.desc: The main citadel of the Kyrian in Bastion, where the Ascended serve. The fates of souls are decided here, and rites of ascension into the Kyrian take place.

shadowlands.name: Eternal Forge
shadowlands.desc: The sacred forge of the Kyrian in Bastion, where weapons and armor are forged. Its fire is sustained by the energy of souls and faith.

shadowlands.name: Elysian Hold
shadowlands.desc: A majestic citadel in Bastion, the stronghold of the Kyrian and their leaders. The defense of Bastion is managed from here, and order is maintained throughout the Shadowlands.

shadowlands.name: Temple of Humility
shadowlands.desc: One of the main temples of Bastion, dedicated to the virtue of Humility. Souls undergo trials here to purify themselves and become Kyrian.

shadowlands.name: Purity's Pinnacle
shadowlands.desc: A high mountain peak in Bastion where the Kyrian perform purification rites. It offers a view of floating temples and endless skies.

shadowlands.name: Aspirant's Crucible
shadowlands.desc: An arena in Bastion where aspirants fight and undergo trials to prove their valor and become Kyrian.

shadowlands.name: Vestibule of Eternity
shadowlands.desc: An ancient hall in Bastion serving as the gateway to the Eternal Forge and other shrines. The Kyrian meet pilgrims here and protect the peace of Bastion.

shadowlands.name: Temple of Courage
shadowlands.desc: A temple in Bastion dedicated to the virtue of Courage. Kyrian are trained here and prepared for battles against the forces of the Maw.

shadowlands.name: Hero's Rest
shadowlands.desc: A refuge in Bastion where heroes fighting for the Shadowlands rest and regain their strength. An atmosphere of peace and honor reigns here.

shadowlands.name: Ardenweald
shadowlands.desc: The realm of eternal nature and the rebirth of souls, connected to the Emerald Dream. Souls rest here before a new cycle, and fairies and wild gods guard the forest.

shadowlands.name: Gormhive
shadowlands.desc: The lair of the gorms — ravenous creatures that devour the life force of Ardenweald. Their queen and countless tunnels are located here.

shadowlands.name: Darkreach
shadowlands.desc: A dark region of Ardenweald stricken by corruption. Trees wither here, and shadows thicken, hiding dangerous creatures.

shadowlands.name: Heart of the Forest
shadowlands.desc: The sacred heart of Ardenweald, the source of life force and the rebirth of souls. Ancient nature magic is kept here.

shadowlands.name: Hibernal Hollow
shadowlands.desc: A quiet hollow in Ardenweald where souls sleep before rebirth. Eternal peace reigns here, guarded by fairies.

shadowlands.name: Tirna Scithe
shadowlands.desc: An ancient grove in Ardenweald where magical trees grow and nature spirits dwell. Rites related to the cycle of life and death take place here.

shadowlands.name: Dreamsong Fenn
shadowlands.desc: A grove in Ardenweald where the song of sleep is heard, lulling souls. Creatures guarding the peace of the sleeping live here.

shadowlands.name: Glitterfall Basin
shadowlands.desc: A picturesque basin in Ardenweald with waterfalls whose waters shimmer with magic. Souls rest here and rare creatures live.

shadowlands.name: Tirna Vaal
shadowlands.desc: One of the tirna of Ardenweald, ancient groves connected to the world of the living. Seeds of the world tree and knowledge of the druids are kept here.

shadowlands.name: Heartwood Grove
shadowlands.desc: A sacred grove in Ardenweald where ancient trees grow, preserving the memory of past cycles. Primordial magic reigns here.

shadowlands.name: Zereth Mortis
shadowlands.desc: The mysterious workshop of the First Ones where the afterlives and the laws of life and death were created. Titan mechanisms float here, and the air is saturated with primordial magic.

shadowlands.name: Sepulcher of the First Ones
shadowlands.desc: A grand structure in Zereth Mortis where the secrets of the First Ones and the entrance to their holy of holies are kept. One of the most dangerous places in the Shadowlands.

shadowlands.name: Catacombs of the Sepulcher
shadowlands.desc: The inner tiers of the Sepulcher of the First Ones, flooded and guarded by mechanisms. Exact information is not yet available on the wiki.

shadowlands.name: Dread Portal
shadowlands.desc: A dark portal in Zereth Mortis leading to unknown dimensions. Its energy distorts space and attracts dangerous creatures.

shadowlands.name: Antecedent Isle
shadowlands.desc: An island in Zereth Mortis where the ancient creations of the First Ones live. Rare artifacts and traces of their civilization can be found here.

shadowlands.name: Path of Inception
shadowlands.desc: A road in Zereth Mortis leading to the Sepulcher of the First Ones. The first creations walked along it to find form and purpose.

shadowlands.name: Haven
shadowlands.desc: A small refuge in Zereth Mortis where travelers can rest and replenish supplies. Calm reigns here amidst mechanical wonders.

shadowlands.name: Forge of Afterlives
shadowlands.desc: A forge in Zereth Mortis where souls are created and reforged. Its mechanisms obey the will of the First Ones.

shadowlands.name: Pilgrim's Grace
shadowlands.desc: A resting place for pilgrims in Zereth Mortis. Exact information is not yet available on the wiki.

shadowlands.name: Exile's Hollow
shadowlands.desc: A secluded hollow in Zereth Mortis where exiles and hermits hide. Exact information is not yet available on the wiki.

shadowlands.name: Maldraxxus
shadowlands.desc: The grim realm of war and necromancy, where the souls of warriors find new life in eternal battle. The houses of Plagues, Rituals, Constructs, and the Chosen fight for power here.

shadowlands.name: House of Plagues
shadowlands.desc: One of the great houses of Maldraxxus, specializing in plague and alchemy. Deadly diseases and poisons are created here.

shadowlands.name: House of Rituals
shadowlands.desc: The House of Maldraxxus where necromancy and rituals are studied. The dead are raised here and dark deals are made.

shadowlands.name: House of Constructs
shadowlands.desc: The House of Maldraxxus where the bodies of the fallen are assembled and rebuilt. Mighty abominations and golems are created here.

shadowlands.name: House of the Chosen
shadowlands.desc: The House of Maldraxxus whose elite serve the Primus directly. The best warriors and commanders are trained here.

shadowlands.name: Seat of the Primus
shadowlands.desc: The throne room of the Primus, ruler of Maldraxxus. The fates of the houses are decided here and the war against the Maw is waged.

shadowlands.name: House of Eyes
shadowlands.desc: The House of Maldraxxus engaged in espionage and reconnaissance. Spies and trackers are trained here.

shadowlands.name: Theater of Pain
shadowlands.desc: An arena in Maldraxxus where bloody battles take place. Warriors fight here for glory and the right to serve their house.

shadowlands.name: Torghast
shadowlands.desc: A cursed tower in the Maw serving as a prison for the most dangerous and valuable prisoners of the Jailer. Its halls constantly change, and powerful servants guard them.

shadowlands.name: The Maw
shadowlands.desc: The darkest corner of the Shadowlands, a prison for the most dangerous souls. The Jailer rules here, and hope has almost faded.

shadowlands.name: Korthia
shadowlands.desc: The ancient City of Secrets, chained to the Maw. The knowledge of the Shadowlands and relics of the First Ones are kept here.

shadowlands.name: Tremaculum
shadowlands.desc: A fortress in Korthia where the servants of the Jailer live. Dark rituals are performed here and prisoners are kept.

shadowlands.name: Crucible of the Damned
shadowlands.desc: A grim place in Korthia where the souls of the damned are reforged. Suffering and darkness reign here.

shadowlands.name: Perdition Hold
shadowlands.desc: A fortress in Korthia serving as a prison and place of torture. The Jailer keeps those who oppose him here.

shadowlands.name: Ve'nari's Refuge
shadowlands.desc: A secret refuge in the Maw where Ve'nari helps heroes. Shelter and valuable information can be found here.

shadowlands.name: Beastwarrens
shadowlands.desc: Beast pits in the Maw where monsters are kept. The Jailer gathers his army here.

shadowlands.name: Keeper's Respite
shadowlands.desc: A refuge in Korthia where the Keeper helps heroes. You can rest here and get quests.

shadowlands.name: Seeker's Quorum
shadowlands.desc: A meeting place in Korthia where seekers exchange knowledge. The secrets of the First Ones are discussed here.

shadowlands.name: Vault of Secrets
shadowlands.desc: An ancient vault in Korthia where the knowledge of the First Ones is locked away. Its halls are guarded by mechanisms and magic.

shadowlands.name: Revendreth
shadowlands.desc: The realm of atonement, where proud souls get a last chance at salvation by purifying themselves through suffering. The venthyr rule here, and Castle Nathria looms over the sinners.

shadowlands.name: Pridefall Hamlet
shadowlands.desc: A grim village in Revendreth where souls unable to atone for their pride dwell. Gloom reigns here.

shadowlands.name: Darkhaven
shadowlands.desc: A city in Revendreth serving as a refuge for those seeking atonement. Allies and quests can be found here.

shadowlands.name: Halls of Atonement
shadowlands.desc: Ancient halls in Revendreth where souls undergo rites of atonement. The venthyr pass judgment on sinners here.

shadowlands.name: Castle Nathria
shadowlands.desc: A majestic castle in Revendreth, the abode of Sire Denathrius. Balls are held and intrigues are woven here.

shadowlands.name: Sinfall
shadowlands.desc: The stronghold of the rebels in Revendreth who oppose Denathrius. They prepare an uprising and seek justice here.
